**"Few words are natural" — few words + natural — few words is state, not goal.**
chapters.tension_cn:
**第 22 章**: "曲则全,枉则直"——6 个对子——"曲/枉/洼/敝/少/不争"才能"全/直/盈/新/得"。

**第 23 章**: "希言自然"——少话+自然——一句话总结——少"暴烈"。

两章是同一件事的两个切面——

> **第 22 章: 6 个对子(具体怎么"少")**
> **第 23 章: 一句话总结(为什么"少"——因为"暴烈"不能久)**

- 第 22 章教你"曲/枉/洼/敝/少/不争"
- 第 23 章教你"为什么是'少'——因为'暴烈'不能久——飘风不终朝"

**"6 个对子"+"为什么是'少'"= 具体+原因 = 你回到"少+自然"。**
chapters.tension_en:
**Chapter 22**: "Bent, then whole; crooked, then straight" — 6 pairs — "bent / crooked / hollow / worn / few / does not contend" is the only way to "whole / straight / full / new / gain".

**Chapter 23**: "Few words are natural" — few words + natural — one-sentence summary — few "fierce".

Two chapters are two facets of the same thing —

> **Chapter 22: 6 pairs (specifically how "few")**
> **Chapter 23: one-sentence summary (why "few" — because "fierce" cannot last)**

- Chapter 22 teaches you "bent / crooked / hollow / worn / few / does not contend"
- Chapter 23 teaches you "why is it 'few' — because 'fierce' cannot last — gale does not last a whole morning"

**"6 pairs" + "why is it few" = specifics + reason = you return to "few + natural".**
chapters.action_cn:
今天你准备"激励"团队之前,**停 3 秒**,问自己——

> "我这个'激励',是'飘风'还是'自然'?"

**如果是"飘风"——暴烈——不终朝——团队疲——别做。**
**如果是"自然"——本来就要讲——不演——可以做。**

**"希言自然"——少话+自然——"自然"是形容词——"少话"是状态——不是目标。**
chapters.action_en:
Before you "motivate" the team today, **stop 3 seconds**, ask yourself —

> "Is my 'motivation' 'gale' or 'natural'?"

**If it is "gale" — fierce — does not last a morning — team tired — do not do it.**
**If it is "natural" — was going to say anyway — not performing — can do.**

**"Few words are natural" — few words + natural — "natural" is adjective — "few words" is state — not goal.**

chapters.original_cn:
企者不立,跨者不行;自见者不明,自是者不彰;自伐者无功,自矜者不长。
其在道也,曰:余食赘行。物或恶之,故有道者不处。
chapters.tongshi_cn:
第 24 章是第 22/23 章的**反面加深**。

第 22 章说"不自见,故明;不自是,故彰;不自伐,故有功;不自矜,故长"——4 个"不自"的正面。
第 24 章直接翻面——"自见者不明,自是者不彰;自伐者无功,自矜者不长"——4 个"自"的反面。
第 24 章还加了一段"为什么"——**"企者不立,跨者不行"——"自"立不住。**

---

**第 1 段: 企者不立,跨者不行。**

"企"= 踮脚;"跨"= 迈大步。

**"企者不立"——踮脚的人——立不住。**
**"跨者不行"——迈大步的人——走不远。**

差别:

- 踮脚 = 站得高 = 老子没说
- 踮脚 = 立不住 = 老子说这个

你想想——

- 一个 PM 踮脚想被看见 = 反而立不住
- 一个 PM 正常站着 = 立得久

**"踮脚"是"强行立"——"强行立" = 立不住。**

- 一个 PM 迈大步想"快速成功" = 反而走不远
- 一个 PM 一步一步走 = 走得远

**"迈大步"是"强行行"——"强行行" = 走不远。**

**"企/跨"——都是"强行"——"强行"都立不住/行不远。**

---

**第 2 段: 自见者不明,自是者不彰;自伐者无功,自矜者不长。**

老子接着把第 22 章的 4 个"不自"翻成"自":

> **自见者不明;**(自己表现的人,不明)
> **自是者不彰;**(自己以为对的人,不彰显)
> **自伐者无功;**(自己夸的人,无功)
> **自矜者不长;**(自己矜的人,不长)

差别:

- 自见 → 明 → 老子没说
- 自见 → 不明 → 老子说这个

**"自"立出来 = 反面立出来。**

**4 个"自"= 4 个"不自"的反面:**

- 自见 vs 不自见 = 不明 vs 明
- 自是 vs 不自是 = 不彰 vs 彰
- 自伐 vs 不自伐 = 无功 vs 有功
- 自矜 vs 不自矜 = 不长 vs 长

**"自"= "立'我'这个标签"= 反面立。**

---

**第 3 段: 其在道也,曰:余食赘行。**

老子盖章"自"的事:

**"其在道也"——这些事在"道"上看——叫——**
**"余食赘行"——"余食"+"赘行"。**

"余食"= 剩饭(吃不完的);"赘"= 多余的;"行"= 行为。

**"余食"——吃不完的饭——剩饭。**
**"赘行"——多余的行为——长出来不该长的肉。**

差别:

- "自见/自是/自伐/自矜"= 不错 → 老子没说
- "自见/自是/自伐/自矜"= "余食赘行"→ 老子说这个

**"自"立出来的事——是"剩饭"——是"多余的长出来"。**

你想想——

- 一个 PM 每天"自见"= 剩饭 = 多余
- 一个 PM 每天"自伐"= 赘行 = 多余

**"余食"——吃不完的——留着的——长出来的——不应该留着。**

---

**第 4 段: 物或恶之,故有道者不处。**

最后一句——老子盖章"自"没人喜欢:

**"物或恶之"——万物/大家——有的会讨厌它。**
**"故有道者不处"——所以有道的人——不站这个位置。**

差别:

- "自"是好事 → 老子没说
- "自"是大家讨厌的 → 老子说这个

**"自"立出来——大家都讨厌——有道的人不站这个位置。**

**"不处"= 不站在"自"这个位置= 不立"我"这个标签。**

---

老子在第 24 章的逻辑是:

**1. "企者不立,跨者不行"——"强行"立不住/行不远**
**2. "自见/自是/自伐/自矜"——4 个"自"——反面立**
**3. "余食赘行"——"自"立出来的事——是"剩饭"+"赘肉"**
**4. "物或恶之"——"自"——大家讨厌**
**5. "有道者不处"——有道的人——不站"自"的位置**

**"企/跨"+"自"+"余食赘行"+"有道者不处" = 老子说"别强行+别'自'"= 自然。**
chapters.tongshi_en:
Chapter 24 is chapters 22/23's **opposite deepening**.

Chapter 22 said "does not show self, therefore bright; does not deem self right, therefore manifest; does not boast self, therefore meritorious; does not pride self, therefore enduring" — 4 "does not self" positive.
Chapter 24 directly flips — "those who show self are not bright; those who deem self right are not manifest; those who boast self are not meritorious; those who pride self are not enduring" — 4 "self" opposite.
Chapter 24 also adds a "why" — **"tiptoeing does not stand" — "self" cannot stand.**

---

**Section 1: Tiptoeing does not stand, striding does not walk.**

"Tiptoe" = stand on tiptoes; "stride" = take long steps.

**"Tiptoeing does not stand" — those who tiptoe — cannot stand.**
**"Striding does not walk" — those who stride — cannot walk far.**

The difference:

- Tiptoe = stand higher → Laozi did not say
- Tiptoe = cannot stand → Laozi said this

Think about it:

- A PM tiptoes to be seen = on the contrary cannot stand
- A PM normally stands = stands long

**"Tiptoeing" is "force standing" — "force standing" = cannot stand.**

- A PM strides to "succeed fast" = on the contrary cannot walk far
- A PM walks step by step = walks far

**"Striding" is "force walking" — "force walking" = cannot walk far.**

**"Tiptoe / stride" — both "force" — "force" both cannot stand / walk far.**

---

**Section 2: Those who show self are not bright, those who deem self right are not manifest; those who boast self are not meritorious, those who pride self are not enduring.**

Laozi then flips chapter 22's 4 "does not self" into "self":

> **Those who show self are not bright;**
> **Those who deem self right are not manifest;**
> **Those who boast self are not meritorious;**
> **Those who pride self are not enduring.**

The difference:

- Show self → bright → Laozi did not say
- Show self → not bright → Laozi said this

**"Self" set out = opposite set out.**

**4 "self" = 4 opposite of "does not self":**

- Show self vs does not show self = not bright vs bright
- Deem self right vs does not deem self right = not manifest vs manifest
- Boast self vs does not boast self = not meritorious vs meritorious
- Pride self vs does not pride self = not enduring vs enduring

**"Self" = "set 'I' as label" = opposite set.**

---

**Section 3: In the Dao, these are called: surplus food, superfluous conduct.**

Laozi stamps the "self" thing:

**"In the Dao" — these things on "Dao" view — called —**
**"Surplus food, superfluous conduct" — "surplus food" + "superfluous conduct".**

"Surplus food" = leftover food (cannot finish eating); "superfluous" = extra; "conduct" = behavior.

**"Surplus food" — food cannot finish — leftovers.**
**"Superfluous conduct" — extra behavior — flesh that grew where it should not.**

The difference:

- "Show self / deem self right / boast self / pride self" = not wrong → Laozi did not say
- "Show self / deem self right / boast self / pride self" = "surplus food superfluous conduct" → Laozi said this

**"Self" set out things — are "leftovers" — are "extra growth".**

Think about it:

- A PM daily "show self" = leftovers = extra
- A PM daily "boast self" = superfluous conduct = extra

**"Surplus" — cannot finish — kept — grown — should not be kept.**

---

**Section 4: Things may dislike them, therefore those who have Dao do not dwell in them.**

Last sentence — Laozi stamps "self" no one likes:

**"Things may dislike them" — all things / everyone — some will dislike it.**
**"Therefore those who have Dao do not dwell in them" — so those who have Dao — do not stand in this position.**

The difference:

- "Self" is good → Laozi did not say
- "Self" is disliked by all → Laozi said this

**"Self" set out — everyone dislikes — those who have Dao do not stand in this position.**

**"Do not dwell in" = do not stand in "self" position = do not set "I" as label.**

---

Laozi's logic in chapter 24:

**1. "Tiptoeing does not stand, striding does not walk" — "force" cannot stand / walk far**
**2. "Show self / deem self right / boast self / pride self" — 4 "self" — opposite set**
**3. "Surplus food superfluous conduct" — "self" set out things — are "leftovers" + "extra flesh"**
**4. "Things may dislike them" — "self" — everyone dislikes**
**5. "Those who have Dao do not dwell in them" — those who have Dao — do not stand in "self" position**

**"Tiptoe / stride" + "self" + "surplus food superfluous conduct" + "those who have Dao do not dwell" = Laozi says "do not force + do not 'self'" = natural.**
chapters.counter_cn:
很多人把第 24 章读成"老子讲做人不要炫耀 / 老子讲做人要低调"。

**反了。**

老子**没说"做人要低调"——他说"自见/自是/自伐/自矜"——是"余食赘行"——是"剩饭赘肉"**。

差别:

- 老子教你低调 → 老子没说
- 老子说"自"= "余食赘行" = 剩饭赘肉 → 老子说这个

**"自"不是"性格问题"——是"多余"——像身上的"赘肉"——长出来不该长的。**

你想想——

- 一个人"自见"= 长出"自见"这个赘肉
- 一个人"自伐"= 长出"自伐"这个赘肉

**"赘"——多出来的——长出来不该长的——"自"就是这个东西。**

**老子没说"低调"——他说"自"= "赘"= 多余——你把它"减"掉就行。**
chapters.counter_en:
Many people read chapter 24 as "Laozi says do not show off / Laozi says be low-key".

**Reversed.**

Laozi **did not say "be low-key" — he said "show self / deem self right / boast self / pride self" — is "surplus food superfluous conduct" — is "leftovers extra flesh"**.

The difference:

- Laozi teaches you to be low-key → Laozi did not say
- Laozi says "self" = "surplus food superfluous conduct" = leftovers extra flesh → Laozi said this

**"Self" is not "personality problem" — is "extra" — like "flesh" on body — grown where should not.**

Think about it:

- A person "show self" = grows "show self" this extra flesh
- A person "boast self" = grows "boast self" this extra flesh

**"Superfluous" — extra — grown where should not — "self" is this thing.**

**Laozi did not say "low-key" — he said "self" = "superfluous" = extra — you just "subtract" it.**
chapters.scene_cn:
你做产品 4 年,在公司里讲"我懂用户" / "我做的是对的" / "我功劳大"。

你本能反应:**"自"**——讲"我懂"——讲"我对"——讲"我有功"——3 年后失去团队信任。

**老子第 24 章的警告是:**

你"自"的那一刻——
- 你讲"我懂用户" = 自见 = 不明
- 你讲"我做的是对的" = 自是 = 不彰
- 你讲"我功劳大" = 自伐 = 无功
- 你讲"我比你们强" = 自矜 = 不长
- **"自"立出来 = "余食赘行"= 大家讨厌 = 立不住/行不远**

差别:

- "自"= 站得高 → 老子没说
- "自"= 站不住/走不远 → 老子说这个

老子第 24 章的诊断:

**"企者不立,跨者不行"——"自"= 强行立——立不住。**

如果你**已经**"自"了——

1. **每次评审你讲"我懂用户"——自见——不明**
2. **每次冲突你讲"我做的是对的"——自是——不彰**
3. **每次汇报你讲"我功劳大"——自伐——无功**
4. **每次同事你讲"我比你们强"——自矜——不长**

**4 条占 1 条,你的"自"在变成"余食赘行"。**

具体怎么做?

1. **不"自见"——不立"我懂"这个标签——让大家自己判断你懂不懂**
2. **不"自是"——不立"我对"这个标签——用数据说话**
3. **不"自伐"——不立"我有功"这个标签——让数据说话**
4. **不"自矜"——不立"我强"这个标签——让大家自己感受**

**"有道者不处"——有道的 PM——不站"自"这个位置——不让"我"立出来。**
chapters.scene_en:
You have been doing product for 4 years, at the company saying "I understand users" / "what I do is right" / "my contribution is great".

Your instinctive reaction: **"self"** — say "I understand" — say "I am right" — say "I have contribution" — 3 years later lost team trust.

**Laozi's chapter 24 warning is:**

The moment you are "self" —
- You say "I understand users" = show self = not bright
- You say "what I do is right" = deem self right = not manifest
- You say "my contribution is great" = boast self = not meritorious
- You say "I am stronger than you" = pride self = not enduring
- **"Self" set out = "surplus food superfluous conduct" = everyone dislikes = cannot stand / walk far**

The difference:

- "Self" = stand higher → Laozi did not say
- "Self" = cannot stand / walk far → Laozi said this

Laozi's chapter 24 diagnosis:

**"Tiptoeing does not stand, striding does not walk" — "self" = force standing — cannot stand.**

If you **have already** been "self" —

1. **Each review you say "I understand users" — show self — not bright**
2. **Each conflict you say "what I do is right" — deem self right — not manifest**
3. **Each report you say "my contribution is great" — boast self — not meritorious**
4. **Each colleague you say "I am stronger than you" — pride self — not enduring**

**1 of 4, your "self" is becoming "surplus food superfluous conduct".**

Specifically how to do?

1. **Do not "show self" — do not set "I understand" this label — let everyone judge whether you understand**
2. **Do not "deem self right" — do not set "I am right" this label — let data speak**
3. **Do not "boast self" — do not set "I have contribution" this label — let data speak**
4. **Do not "pride self" — do not set "I am strong" this label — let everyone feel themselves**

**"Those who have Dao do not dwell in them" — PM who has Dao — do not stand in "self" position — do not let "I" set out.**
chapters.tension_cn:
**第 23 章**: "希言自然"——少话+自然——"飘风不终朝"——暴烈不能久。

**第 24 章**: "企者不立,跨者不行"——强行立的人立不住——"自"立出来 = "余食赘行"。

两章是同一件事的两个切面——

> **第 23 章: "少"(少话+少暴烈)**
> **第 24 章: "不自"(不立"我"这个标签)**

- 第 23 章教你"少+自然"
- 第 24 章教你"不自+有道者不处"

**"少"+"不自"= 老子说"别多"——"自"= "余食赘行"= 多余。**

**"希言"+"不自" = 老子说"少+不自"= 自然。**
chapters.tension_en:
**Chapter 23**: "Few words are natural" — few words + natural — "gale does not last a whole morning" — fierce cannot last.

**Chapter 24**: "Tiptoeing does not stand, striding does not walk" — those who force standing cannot stand — "self" set out = "surplus food superfluous conduct".

Two chapters are two facets of the same thing —

> **Chapter 23: "few" (few words + few fierce)**
> **Chapter 24: "does not self" (do not set "I" this label)**

- Chapter 23 teaches you "few + natural"
- Chapter 24 teaches you "does not self + those who have Dao do not dwell"

**"Few" + "does not self" = Laozi says "do not be more" — "self" = "surplus food superfluous conduct" = extra.**

**"Few words" + "does not self" = Laozi says "few + does not self" = natural.**
chapters.action_cn:
今天你准备讲"我懂" / "我对" / "我有功" / "我强"之前,**停 3 秒**,问自己——

> "这个'自',是'该长'的,还是'赘'的?"

**如果是"赘"的——"余食赘行"——大家讨厌——别讲。**
**如果是"该长"的——讲出来——自然——可以讲。**

**"有道者不处"——有道的 PM——不站"自"这个位置——不让"我"立出来。**
chapters.action_en:
Before you say "I understand" / "I am right" / "I have contribution" / "I am strong" today, **stop 3 seconds**, ask yourself —

> "Is this 'self' 'should grow' or 'superfluous'?"

**If it is "superfluous" — "surplus food superfluous conduct" — everyone dislikes — do not say.**
**If it is "should grow" — say it — natural — can say.**

**"Those who have Dao do not dwell in them" — PM who has Dao — do not stand in "self" position — do not let "I" set out.**

chapters.original_cn:
有物混成,先天地生,寂兮寥兮,独立而不改,周行而不殆,可以为天地母。
吾不知其名,字之曰道,强为之名曰大。
大曰逝,逝曰远,远曰反。
故道大,天大,地大,人亦大。域中有四大,而人居其一焉。
人法地,地法天,天法道,道法自然。
chapters.original_en:
There is a thing, mixed and formed,
born before heaven and earth.
Silent, empty,
standing alone, unchanging,
revolving, never weary.
It can be considered the mother of heaven and earth.
I do not know its name,
I call it Dao.
Compelled to name it, I call it great.
Great, thus passing away;
passing away, thus far;
far, thus returning.
Therefore Dao is great, heaven is great, earth is great, people are great.
In the realm there are four greats, and people are one of them.
People follow earth,
earth follows heaven,
heaven follows Dao,
Dao follows nature.
chapters.tongshi_cn:
第 25 章是第 21/24 章的**最根本版**。

第 21 章说"道"恍恍惚惚但有信——但还没说"道"长啥样。
第 24 章说"自"立出来 = 余食赘行。
第 25 章直接给"道"的形态——

> **"有物混成,先天地生"——有一个"东西"——混在一起成的——比天地先生出来。**

---

**第 1 段: 有物混成,先天地生,寂兮寥兮,独立而不改,周行而不殆,可以为天地母。**

老子直接给"道"的画像:

> **"有物混成"——有一个"东西"——混在一起成的。**
> **"先天地生"——比天地先生出来。**
> **"寂兮寥兮"——安静啊——空旷啊。**
> **"独立而不改"——独立运行——不改变。**
> **"周行而不殆"——循环运行——不疲惫。**
> **"可以为天地母"——可以作天地的"母"。**

差别:

- "有物混成"= 看得见的"物" → 老子没说
- "有物混成"= 混在一起成的"东西"——看不见摸不着 → 老子说这个

**"物"——在老子这里——不是"看得见摸得着的物"——是"混在一起成的'东西'"——这个"东西"是"道"的别名。**

你想想——

- "物"= 物质 → 老子没说
- "物"= 那个"混在一起成的'东西'"= 道 → 老子说这个

**"有物"= "有道"——道= 那个混在一起成的东西。**

接着老子说"寂兮寥兮"——**"道"的状态——安静——空旷。**

差别:

- "道"= 热闹 / 满 → 老子没说
- "道"= 安静 / 空旷 → 老子说这个

**"寂"= 没声音;"寥"= 没东西。"道"= 没声音 + 没东西——但"有"——这个"有"是"可以为天地母"。**

**"独立而不改"——"道"独立运行——不改变——自己就是自己。**

**"周行而不殆"——"道"循环运行——不疲惫——一直在走。**

**"可以为天地母"——可以作天地的"母"——天地由"道"生。**

---

**第 2 段: 吾不知其名,字之曰道,强为之名曰大。**

老子承认**他自己不知道"它"叫啥**:

> **"吾不知其名"——我不知道"它"的名字。**
> **"字之曰道"——我给它起字叫"道"。**
> **"强为之名曰大"——勉强给它起名叫"大"。**

差别:

- "道"= 老子的本名 → 老子没说
- "道"= 老子**勉强**起的字 → 老子说这个

**老子没说"道"是真名——他说"道"是"字"——是"别号"——"真名我不知道"。**

**"强为之名曰大"——"强"——勉强——给"它"勉强起名"大"——"大"也是勉强。**

**老子两次承认:"我不知道"+"勉强"。**

---

**第 3 段: 大曰逝,逝曰远,远曰反。**

接着老子给"大"的画像:

> **"大曰逝"——"大"叫"逝"——往前往。**
> **"逝曰远"——"逝"叫"远"——往远。**
> **"远曰反"——"远"叫"反"——返回。**

差别:

- 大 → 远 → 不返回 → 老子没说
- 大 → 逝 → 远 → 反(返) → 老子说这个

**"大"= 往前往——"逝"= 往远——"远"到极处 = "反"(返)——返回来。**

你想想——

- 一个产品从 0 到 1 = 逝 = 远
- 1 到极处 = 反(返) = 回到 0——但这个"0"是升级版的 0
- **"反"不是"回到原点"——是"远到极处返回来"——返= 回到"道"**

---

**第 4 段: 故道大,天大,地大,人亦大。域中有四大,而人居其一焉。**

老子给 4 个"大":

> **"道大,天大,地大,人亦大"——道大——天大——地大——人也大。**
> **"域中有四大"——域(空间/宇宙)中有 4 个"大"。**
> **"而人居其一焉"——人是其中 1 个。**

差别:

- 4 个"大"= 平级 → 老子没说
- 4 个"大"= 有顺序(道 → 天 → 地 → 人) → 老子说这个

**"道大"= 第一个;"天大"= 第二个;"地大"= 第三个;"人大"= 第四个。**

**人不是最大的——"道"是最大的——"人"是 1/4。**

---

**第 5 段: 人法地,地法天,天法道,道法自然。**

最有名的一段——也是最容易误读的一段:

> **"人法地"——人效法地。**
> **"地法天"——地效法天。**
> **"天法道"——天效法道。**
> **"道法自然"——道效法"自然"。**

差别:

- "道法自然"= 道效法自然 → 错(最常见的误读)
- "道法自然"= 道= 自然 → 老子说这个

**"道法自然"——"自然"= "自己如此"= "道"的另一个名字——"道效法'自己如此'"——这等于说"道效法自己"。**

你想想——

- "道法自然"= "道效法自然"= 道有一个比自己更高的东西叫"自然"→ 错
- "道法自然"= "道= 自然"= 道= 自己 → 老子说这个

**"自然"——不是"大自然"——不是"自然界"——是"自己如此"——"自"+"然"。**

**"自"= 自己;"然"= 如此。**

**"道法自然"= 道= 自己如此 = 道= 自己的样子。**

差别:

- "道"有一个比自己更高的"自然" → 老子没说
- "道"= 自己如此 → 老子说这个

**"自然"= "道"的另一个名字——"道= 自然"。**

---

老子在第 25 章的逻辑是:

**1. "有物混成"——"道"是一个混在一起成的"东西"——比天地先生**
**2. "寂兮寥兮"——"道"安静+空旷——没声音没东西——但"有"**
**3. "独立而不改,周行而不殆"——"道"独立循环运行——不改变不疲惫**
**4. "可以为天地母"——"道"是天地之母**
**5. "大曰逝,逝曰远,远曰反"——"大"= 往前往= 往远= 远到极处= 返回**
**6. "道大,天大,地大,人亦大"——4 个"大"——但"道"是第一个**
**7. "道法自然"——"道"= "自然"= "自己如此"**

**"道"= 母+大+自然 = 老子给"道"的画像——不是"宇宙本源"——是"那个比你大的'自己如此'"。**
chapters.tongshi_en:
Chapter 25 is chapters 21/24's **most fundamental version**.

Chapter 21 said "Dao" is vague and elusive but with faith — but did not say what "Dao" looks like.
Chapter 24 said "self" set out = surplus food superfluous conduct.
Chapter 25 directly gives "Dao"'s image —

> **"There is a thing, mixed and formed, born before heaven and earth" — there is a "thing" — mixed and formed — born before heaven and earth.**

---

**Section 1: There is a thing, mixed and formed, born before heaven and earth, silent, empty, standing alone unchanging, revolving never weary, can be considered the mother of heaven and earth.**

Laozi directly gives "Dao"'s portrait:

> **"There is a thing, mixed and formed" — there is a "thing" — mixed and formed.**
> **"Born before heaven and earth" — born before heaven and earth.**
> **"Silent, empty" — silent ah — empty ah.**
> **"Standing alone, unchanging" — standing alone running — unchanging.**
> **"Revolving, never weary" — revolving running — never weary.**
> **"Can be considered the mother of heaven and earth" — can be the "mother" of heaven and earth.**

The difference:

- "There is a thing" = visible "thing" → Laozi did not say
- "There is a thing" = mixed and formed "thing" — cannot see or touch → Laozi said this

**"Thing" — in Laozi here — is not "visible touchable thing" — is "mixed and formed 'thing'" — this "thing" is another name for "Dao".**

Think about it:

- "Thing" = matter → Laozi did not say
- "Thing" = that "mixed and formed 'thing'" = Dao → Laozi said this

**"There is a thing" = "there is Dao" — Dao = that mixed and formed thing.**

Then Laozi says "silent, empty" — **"Dao"'s state — silent — empty.**

The difference:

- "Dao" = noisy / full → Laozi did not say
- "Dao" = silent / empty → Laozi said this

**"Silent" = no sound; "empty" = no thing. "Dao" = no sound + no thing — but "has" — this "has" is "can be mother of heaven and earth".**

**"Standing alone, unchanging" — "Dao" stands alone running — unchanging — itself is itself.**

**"Revolving, never weary" — "Dao" revolves running — never weary — always going.**

**"Can be considered the mother of heaven and earth" — can be heaven and earth's "mother" — heaven and earth born from "Dao".**

---

**Section 2: I do not know its name, I call it Dao. Compelled to name it, I call it great.**

Laozi admits **he himself does not know what "it" is called**:

> **"I do not know its name" — I do not know "it"'s name.**
> **"I call it Dao" — I give it style name "Dao".**
> **"Compelled to name it, I call it great" — compelled to give it name call it "great".**

The difference:

- "Dao" = Laozi's real name → Laozi did not say
- "Dao" = Laozi **compelled to give** style name → Laozi said this

**Laozi did not say "Dao" is the real name — he said "Dao" is "style name" — is "alias" — "real name I do not know".**

**"Compelled to name it great" — "compelled" — reluctantly — give "it" reluctantly name "great" — "great" is also compelled.**

**Laozi twice admits: "I do not know" + "compelled".**

---

**Section 3: Great, thus passing away; passing away, thus far; far, thus returning.**

Then Laozi gives "great"'s portrait:

> **"Great, thus passing away" — "great" is called "passing away" — go forward.**
> **"Passing away, thus far" — "passing away" is called "far" — go far.**
> **"Far, thus returning" — "far" is called "returning" — return.**

The difference:

- Great → far → does not return → Laozi did not say
- Great → passing away → far → returning → Laozi said this

**"Great" = go forward — "passing away" = go far — "far" to extreme = "returning" — return.**

Think about it:

- A product from 0 to 1 = passing away = far
- 1 to extreme = returning = return to 0 — but this "0" is upgraded 0
- **"Returning" is not "return to origin" — is "far to extreme return" — returning = return to "Dao"**

---

**Section 4: Therefore Dao is great, heaven is great, earth is great, people are great. In the realm there are four greats, and people are one of them.**

Laozi gives 4 "great":

> **"Dao is great, heaven is great, earth is great, people are great" — Dao great — heaven great — earth great — people also great.**
> **"In the realm there are four greats" — realm (space / universe) has 4 "great".**
> **"And people are one of them" — people are 1 of them.**

The difference:

- 4 "great" = same level → Laozi did not say
- 4 "great" = have order (Dao → heaven → earth → people) → Laozi said this

**"Dao great" = first; "heaven great" = second; "earth great" = third; "people great" = fourth.**

**People are not the greatest — "Dao" is the greatest — "people" is 1/4.**

---

**Section 5: People follow earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows Dao, Dao follows nature.**

The most famous paragraph — also the most easily misread paragraph:

> **"People follow earth" — people follow earth.**
> **"Earth follows heaven" — earth follows heaven.**
> **"Heaven follows Dao" — heaven follows Dao.**
> **"Dao follows nature" — Dao follows "nature".**

The difference:

- "Dao follows nature" = Dao follows nature → wrong (most common misread)
- "Dao follows nature" = Dao = nature → Laozi said this

**"Dao follows nature" — "nature" = "self-so" = another name for "Dao" — "Dao follows 'self-so'" — this equals "Dao follows itself".**

Think about it:

- "Dao follows nature" = "Dao follows nature" = Dao has something higher than itself called "nature" → wrong
- "Dao follows nature" = "Dao = nature" = Dao = itself → Laozi said this

**"Nature" — is not "big nature" — is not "natural world" — is "self-so" — "self" + "so".**

**"Self" = self; "so" = so.**

**"Dao follows nature" = Dao = self-so = Dao = its own appearance.**

The difference:

- "Dao" has something higher than itself called "nature" → Laozi did not say
- "Dao" = self-so → Laozi said this

**"Nature" = another name for "Dao" — "Dao = nature".**

---

Laozi's logic in chapter 25:

**1. "There is a thing, mixed and formed" — "Dao" is a mixed and formed "thing" — born before heaven and earth**
**2. "Silent, empty" — "Dao" silent + empty — no sound no thing — but "has"**
**3. "Standing alone unchanging, revolving never weary" — "Dao" stands alone revolving running — unchanging not weary**
**4. "Can be considered the mother of heaven and earth" — "Dao" is heaven and earth's mother**
**5. "Great, thus passing away; passing away, thus far; far, thus returning" — "great" = go forward = go far = far to extreme = return**
**6. "Dao is great, heaven is great, earth is great, people are great" — 4 "great" — but "Dao" is the first**
**7. "Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "nature" = "self-so"**

**"Dao" = mother + great + nature = Laozi gives "Dao"'s portrait — is not "universe origin" — is "that 'self-so' bigger than you".**
chapters.counter_cn:
很多人把第 25 章读成"老子讲宇宙本源 / 老子讲四大 / 老子讲'道法自然'是'道效法自然'"。

**反了。**

老子**没说"道效法自然"——他说"道= 自然"——"道法自然"= "道= 自己如此"**。

差别:

- "道法自然"= 道效法自然 → 老子没说(最常见的误读)
- "道法自然"= 道= 自然 → 老子说这个

**"自然"不是"大自然"——不是"自然界"——是"自"+"然"——"自己如此"。**

你想想——

- 一个人"自然"= 大自然 → 老子没说
- 一个人"自然"= 这个人本来就是这样的 → 老子说这个

**"自然"= 本来就这样= 道本来就是这样的= 道= 自己。**

**"道法自然"——"道"= "自己如此"——不是"道有一个比自己更高的东西"。**
chapters.counter_en:
Many people read chapter 25 as "Laozi speaks of universe origin / Laozi speaks of four greats / Laozi speaks of 'Dao follows nature' as 'Dao follows nature'".

**Reversed.**

Laozi **did not say "Dao follows nature" — he said "Dao = nature" — "Dao follows nature" = "Dao = self-so"**.

The difference:

- "Dao follows nature" = Dao follows nature → Laozi did not say (most common misread)
- "Dao follows nature" = Dao = nature → Laozi said this

**"Nature" is not "big nature" — is not "natural world" — is "self" + "so" — "self-so".**

Think about it:

- A person "natural" = big nature → Laozi did not say
- A person "natural" = this person was originally like this → Laozi said this

**"Nature" = originally like this = Dao was originally like this = Dao = itself.**

**"Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "self-so" — is not "Dao has something higher than itself".**
chapters.scene_cn:
你做产品 4 年,立"远大目标"——"明年上市"——"3 年做到 100 万 DAU"——3 年后撑不住。

你本能反应:**更远大**——再加目标——再加 KPI——1 年后崩溃。

**老子第 25 章的警告是:**

你立"远大目标"的那一刻——
- "远大"= 往远 = 但**远到极处 = 反(返)= 回到"自然"= 回到"你本来是谁"**
- 你立"远大"= 不让自己"自然"= 立"远大"这个标签 = 反"自然"
- **"远大"标签 = 立"我"这个标签 = 不自然 = 撑不住**

差别:

- "远大"= 远到不反 → 老子没说
- "远大"= 远到极处 = 反(返)= 回到自然 → 老子说这个

老子第 25 章的诊断:

**"道法自然"——"道"= "自然"= "自己如此"——你别立"远大"——回到"你本来是谁"。**

如果你**已经**立了"远大目标"——

1. **你立"明年上市"——远——但远到极处=反=回到"我现在做的这个产品"**
2. **你立"3 年 100 万 DAU"——远——但远到极处=反=回到"今天的数据"**
3. **你立"成为赛道第一"——远——但远到极处=反=回到"我为什么要做产品"**
4. **你立"用户第一"——远——但远到极处=反=回到"用户真的卡什么"**

**4 条占 1 条,你的"远大"在变成立"我"这个标签。**

具体怎么做?

1. **删"远大目标"——别立可见的"大"**
2. **回到"自然"——回到"你本来是谁"**
3. **回到"今天"——回到"现在做的这个产品"**
4. **回到"用户真的卡什么"——回到"那个恍恍惚惚但有信的道"**

**"道法自然"——"道"= "自己如此"——别立"远大"——回到"我本来是谁"。**
chapters.scene_en:
You have been doing product for 4 years, set "grand goal" — "IPO next year" — "1 million DAU in 3 years" — 3 years later cannot hold.

Your instinctive reaction: **more grand** — add more goal — add more KPI — 1 year later collapse.

**Laozi's chapter 25 warning is:**

The moment you set "grand goal" —
- "Grand" = go far = but **far to extreme = return = return to "nature" = return to "who you originally are"**
- You set "grand" = do not let yourself "natural" = set "grand" as label = opposite of "natural"
- **"Grand" label = set "I" as label = not natural = cannot hold**

The difference:

- "Grand" = far without return → Laozi did not say
- "Grand" = far to extreme = return = return to nature → Laozi said this

Laozi's chapter 25 diagnosis:

**"Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "nature" = "self-so" — do not set "grand" — return to "who you originally are".**

If you **have already** set "grand goal" —

1. **You set "IPO next year" — far — but far to extreme = return = return to "this product I am doing now"**
2. **You set "1 million DAU in 3 years" — far — but far to extreme = return = return to "today's data"**
3. **You set "become category leader" — far — but far to extreme = return = return to "why I do product"**
4. **You set "user first" — far — but far to extreme = return = return to "where user is really stuck"**

**1 of 4, your "grand" is becoming setting "I" as label.**

Specifically how to do?

1. **Delete "grand goal" — do not set visible "great"**
2. **Return to "nature" — return to "who you originally are"**
3. **Return to "today" — return to "this product I am doing now"**
4. **Return to "where user is really stuck" — return to "that vague and elusive but with faith Dao"**

**"Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "self-so" — do not set "grand" — return to "who you originally are".**
chapters.tension_cn:
**第 24 章**: "企者不立"——强行立的人立不住——"自"= "余食赘行"。

**第 25 章**: "道法自然"——"道"= "自己如此"——"远大"= 远到极处= 反= 回到自然。

两章是同一件事的两个切面——

> **第 24 章: "不自"(不立"我"这个标签)**
> **第 25 章: "道法自然"(道= 自己= 自然)**

- 第 24 章教你"别'自'——别立'我'这个标签"
- 第 25 章教你"'道'= '自然'= '自己如此'——回到'自己'"

**"不自"+"道法自然"= 老子说"别立我"+"回到自己"= 你在"道"。**
chapters.tension_en:
**Chapter 24**: "Tiptoeing does not stand" — those who force standing cannot stand — "self" = "surplus food superfluous conduct".

**Chapter 25**: "Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "nature" = "self-so" — "grand" = far to extreme = return = return to nature.

Two chapters are two facets of the same thing —

> **Chapter 24: "does not self" (do not set "I" as label)**
> **Chapter 25: "Dao follows nature" (Dao = self = nature)**

- Chapter 24 teaches you "do not 'self' — do not set 'I' as label"
- Chapter 25 teaches you "'Dao' = 'nature' = 'self-so' — return to 'self'"

**"Does not self" + "Dao follows nature" = Laozi says "do not set I" + "return to self" = you are in "Dao".**
chapters.action_cn:
今天你准备立"远大目标"之前,**停 3 秒**,问自己——

> "这个'远大',远到极处 = 反(返)= 回到哪儿?"

**如果"返"= 回到"远大"= 撑不住——别立。**
**如果"返"= 回到"自然"= 回到"我本来是谁"——可以立。**

**"道法自然"——"道"= "自己如此"——别立"远大"——回到"我本来是谁"。**
chapters.action_en:
Before you set "grand goal" today, **stop 3 seconds**, ask yourself —

> "This 'grand', far to extreme = return = return where?"

**If "return" = return to "grand" = cannot hold — do not set.**
**If "return" = return to "nature" = return to "who you originally are" — can set.**

**"Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "self-so" — do not set "grand" — return to "who you originally are".**

chapters.original_cn:
重为轻根,静为躁君。
是以圣人终日行不离辎重,虽有荣观,燕处超然。
奈何万乘之主,而以身轻天下?
轻则失根,躁则失君。
chapters.original_en:
Heavy is the root of light;
stillness is the lord of motion.
Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his heavy baggage.
Though there are beautiful sights,
he stays at ease, beyond them.
Why should the lord of ten thousand chariots
treat his own person lighter than the world?
Light, then loses the root;
motion, then loses the lord.
chapters.tongshi_cn:
第 26 章是第 25 章的**具体做法**。

第 25 章说"道法自然"——道= 自然= 自己。
第 26 章直接给"具体怎么回到'重'"——

> **"重为轻根,静为躁君"——重是轻的根,静是躁的君。**

---

**第 1 句: 重为轻根,静为躁君。**

"重"= 重(物理的/态度的);"轻"= 轻;"根"= 根本。
"静"= 安静;"躁"= 急躁;"君"= 君主(主)。

差别:

- 轻在前,重在后 → 老子没说
- 重在前,轻在后(重是根本) → 老子说这个

**"重为轻根"——"重"是"轻"的根本——"重"在前,"轻"在后。**

你想想——

- 一棵树**轻**的叶子在上面 = 飘 = 不稳
- 一棵树**重**的根在下面 = 稳

**"轻"的东西之所以能"轻"——是因为底下有"重"——"重"是"轻"的根。**

**"静为躁君"——"静"是"躁"的君主——"静"在前,"躁"在后——"静"是"躁"的主人。**

差别:

- 躁在前,静在后 → 老子没说
- 静在前,躁在后(静是主人) → 老子说这个

**"躁"的人——是因为有"静"的人在管——"静"是"躁"的"君"(主人)。**

---

**第 2 段: 是以圣人终日行不离辎重,虽有荣观,燕处超然。**

老子用"圣人"做例子:

> **"是以圣人终日行不离辎重"——所以圣人整天走——不离辎重。**
> **"虽有荣观,燕处超然"——虽有荣华观(荣华)——安处超然。**

"辎重"= 出远门带的行李(重物);"荣观"= 荣华;"燕处"= 安处;"超然"= 超然(超出)。

**"终日行不离辎重"——圣人整天走——不离"辎重"——每天带着"重"走。**

差别:

- 圣人整天走 = 轻装 → 老子没说
- 圣人整天走 = 不离"辎重"(重) → 老子说这个

**"辎重"= "重"——圣人的"重"是"根本"——圣人每天带着"根本"走。**

你想想——

- 一个 PM 每天做产品 = 不离"根"——根是"用户真的卡什么"
- 一个 PM 每天做产品 = 离"根"——只看"行业在做什么"

**"不离辎重"——不离"根本"——每天带着"根本"走。**

**"虽有荣观,燕处超然"——虽有荣华——安处超然。**

差别:

- 荣华 = 沉溺 → 老子没说
- 荣华 = 还能"燕"(安)处——超然 → 老子说这个

**"燕"——安——在荣华里还能"安"——超然——不沉溺。**

---

**第 3 段: 奈何万乘之主,而以身轻天下?**

老子给"反问":

**"奈何万乘之主,而以身轻天下"——为什么——万乘之主(大国君主)——以"轻"的态度对待天下?**

"万乘"= 万辆兵车(大国);"以身轻天下"= 用"身轻"(轻率)的态度对待天下。

差别:

- 大国君主 = 用"重"对待天下 → 老子没说
- 大国君主 = 反问——为什么以"轻"对待天下 → 老子说这个

**老子在反问——为什么大国君主"以身轻天下"——为什么"轻"对待天下?**

---

**第 4 句: 轻则失根,躁则失君。**

老子盖章:

**"轻则失根"——"轻"——则失"根"——失去"重"这个根。**
**"躁则失君"——"躁"——则失"君"——失去"静"这个主。**

差别:

- 轻 = 还在根 → 老子没说
- 轻 = 失根 → 老子说这个

**"轻"——"根"没了——没有"重"这个根。**

**"躁"——"君"没了——没有"静"这个主人。**

---

老子在第 26 章的逻辑是:

**1. "重为轻根"——"重"是"轻"的根——重在前,轻在后**
**2. "静为躁君"——"静"是"躁"的君——静在前,躁在后**
**3. "圣人终日行不离辎重"——圣人每天带着"重"走**
**4. "虽有荣观,燕处超然"——虽有荣华,还能安处超然**
**5. "奈何万乘之主,而以身轻天下"——为什么大国君主"轻"对待天下——反问**
**6. "轻则失根,躁则失君"——"轻"则失"根","躁"则失"君"**

**"重/静"+"不离辎重"+"燕处超然"+"失根/失君"= 老子说"守重+守静"——别"轻"——别"躁"。**
chapters.tongshi_en:
Chapter 26 is chapter 25's **concrete practice**.

Chapter 25 said "Dao follows nature" — Dao = nature = itself.
Chapter 26 directly gives "specifically how to return to 'heavy'" —

> **"Heavy is the root of light, stillness is the lord of motion" — heavy is light's root, stillness is motion's lord.**

---

**Sentence 1: Heavy is the root of light, stillness is the lord of motion.**

"Heavy" = heavy (physical / attitude); "light" = light; "root" = foundation.
"Stillness" = quiet; "motion" = restless; "lord" = sovereign (master).

The difference:

- Light first, heavy after → Laozi did not say
- Heavy first, light after (heavy is foundation) → Laozi said this

**"Heavy is the root of light" — "heavy" is "light"'s foundation — "heavy" first, "light" after.**

Think about it:

- A tree's **light** leaves on top = float = not steady
- A tree's **heavy** root at bottom = steady

**Why "light" can be "light" — is because underneath there is "heavy" — "heavy" is "light"'s root.**

**"Stillness is the lord of motion" — "stillness" is "motion"'s sovereign — "stillness" first, "motion" after — "stillness" is "motion"'s master.**

The difference:

- Motion first, stillness after → Laozi did not say
- Stillness first, motion after (stillness is master) → Laozi said this

**The "motion" person — is because there is a "stillness" person managing — "stillness" is "motion"'s "lord" (master).**

---

**Section 2: Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his heavy baggage. Though there are beautiful sights, he stays at ease, beyond them.**

Laozi uses "sage" as example:

> **"Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his heavy baggage" — so the sage travels all day — does not leave heavy baggage.**
> **"Though there are beautiful sights, he stays at ease, beyond them" — though there are beautiful sights (glory) — stays at ease, beyond.**

"Heavy baggage" = luggage for long journey (heavy thing); "beautiful sights" = glory; "stays at ease" = stays at ease; "beyond" = transcend.

**"Travels all day without leaving his heavy baggage" — the sage travels all day — does not leave "heavy baggage" — every day carries "heavy" with him.**

The difference:

- Sage travels all day = light load → Laozi did not say
- Sage travels all day = does not leave "heavy baggage" (heavy) → Laozi said this

**"Heavy baggage" = "heavy" — the sage's "heavy" is "foundation" — the sage every day carries "foundation" with him.**

Think about it:

- A PM every day does product = does not leave "root" — root is "where user is really stuck"
- A PM every day does product = leaves "root" — only looks at "what industry is doing"

**"Does not leave heavy baggage" — does not leave "foundation" — every day carries "foundation" with him.**

**"Though there are beautiful sights, he stays at ease, beyond them" — though there is glory — can "stay at ease" — beyond — not indulge.**

The difference:

- Glory = indulge → Laozi did not say
- Glory = can still "stay at ease" — beyond → Laozi said this

**"Stays at ease" — at ease — in glory still can "stay at ease" — beyond — not indulge.**

---

**Section 3: Why should the lord of ten thousand chariots treat his own person lighter than the world?**

Laozi gives "rhetorical question":

**"Why should the lord of ten thousand chariots treat his own person lighter than the world" — why — lord of ten thousand chariots (great country sovereign) — use "light" (light-minded) attitude to treat the world?**

"Ten thousand chariots" = ten thousand war chariots (great country); "treat his own person lighter than the world" = use "light" (light-minded) attitude to treat the world.

The difference:

- Great country sovereign = use "heavy" to treat the world → Laozi did not say
- Great country sovereign = rhetorical question — why use "light" to treat the world → Laozi said this

**Laozi is asking — why does a great country sovereign "use light to treat the world" — why "light" treat the world?**

---

**Sentence 4: Light, then loses the root; motion, then loses the lord.**

Laozi stamps:

**"Light, then loses the root" — "light" — then loses "root" — loses "heavy" this root.**
**"Motion, then loses the lord" — "motion" — then loses "lord" — loses "stillness" this master.**

The difference:

- Light = still has root → Laozi did not say
- Light = loses root → Laozi said this

**"Light" — "root" is gone — no "heavy" this root.**

**"Motion" — "lord" is gone — no "stillness" this master.**

---

Laozi's logic in chapter 26:

**1. "Heavy is the root of light" — "heavy" is "light"'s root — heavy first, light after**
**2. "Stillness is the lord of motion" — "stillness" is "motion"'s lord — stillness first, motion after**
**3. "The sage travels all day without leaving his heavy baggage" — sage every day carries "heavy" with him**
**4. "Though there are beautiful sights, he stays at ease, beyond them" — though there is glory, can stay at ease beyond**
**5. "Why should the lord of ten thousand chariots treat his own person lighter than the world" — why does great country sovereign "light" treat the world — rhetorical question**
**6. "Light, then loses the root; motion, then loses the lord" — "light" then loses "root", "motion" then loses "lord"**

**"Heavy / stillness" + "does not leave heavy baggage" + "stays at ease beyond" + "loses root / loses lord" = Laozi says "guard heavy + guard stillness" — do not "light" — do not "motion".**
chapters.counter_cn:
很多人把第 26 章读成"老子讲稳重 / 老子讲安静 / 老子讲稳重安静的人赢了"。

**反了。**

老子**没说"稳重就赢"——他说"重为轻根"——"重"是"轻"的根——"重"在前,"轻"在后——"重"是"根本"**。

差别:

- 老子讲稳重就赢 → 老子没说
- 老子讲"重"="根"="在先" → 老子说这个

**"重"不是"性格"——是"在先"——是"根本"——"轻"能存在是因为底下有"重"。**

你想想——

- 一个产品能"轻"(轻量级) = 因为底下有"重"(核心功能)
- 一个产品能"轻"= 但底下没"重"= 飘 = 失根

**"轻"不一定是坏——"轻"没"根"才是坏——"重为轻根"= 守住"重"= 守住"根本"。**
chapters.counter_en:
Many people read chapter 26 as "Laozi says be steady / Laozi says be quiet / Laozi says steady quiet people win".

**Reversed.**

Laozi **did not say "steady wins" — he said "heavy is the root of light" — "heavy" is "light"'s root — "heavy" is first, "light" is after — "heavy" is "foundation"**.

The difference:

- Laozi says steady wins → Laozi did not say
- Laozi says "heavy" = "root" = "first" → Laozi said this

**"Heavy" is not "personality" — is "first" — is "foundation" — "light" can exist because underneath there is "heavy".**

Think about it:

- A product can be "light" (lightweight) = because underneath there is "heavy" (core feature)
- A product can be "light" = but underneath no "heavy" = float = loses root

**"Light" is not necessarily bad — "light" without "root" is bad — "heavy is the root of light" = guard "heavy" = guard "foundation".**
chapters.scene_cn:
你做产品 3 年,做轻量级 SaaS 工具。

你本能反应:**轻**——快迭代——轻功能——轻团队——3 年后飘——用户流失。

**老子第 26 章的警告是:**

你"轻"的那一刻——
- 快迭代 = 轻 = 但失了"重"= 失了"根"= 失了"用户真的卡什么"
- 轻功能 = 轻 = 但失了"重"= 失了"根"功能
- 轻团队 = 轻 = 但失了"重"= 失了"核心 3 个人"
- **"轻"没"重"——失根——失君——失败**

差别:

- "轻"= 没事 → 老子没说
- "轻"= 失根 → 老子说这个

老子第 26 章的诊断:

**"重为轻根"——"重"是"轻"的根——你守"重"= 守"用户真的卡什么"。**

如果你**已经**"轻"了——

1. **你只追"快速上线"——轻——失了"用户真的卡什么"——失根**
2. **你只做"轻功能"——轻——失了"核心功能"——失根**
3. **你只让"轻团队"做——轻——失了"核心 3 个人"——失根**
4. **你天天讲"我们要轻"——轻——失了"我们为什么做"——失根**

**4 条占 1 条,你的"轻"在失"重"。**

具体怎么做?

1. **回到"用户真的卡什么"——守住"重"——这是"根"**
2. **做"核心功能"——别做"轻功能"——守住"重"**
3. **让"核心 3 个人"做核心——别让"轻团队"做核心——守住"重"**
4. **回到"我们为什么做"——守住"重"——这是"根本"**

**"重为轻根"——"重"是"轻"的根——守住"重"——"轻"才能"轻"得起。**
chapters.scene_en:
You have been doing product for 3 years, making a lightweight SaaS tool.

Your instinctive reaction: **light** — fast iteration — light feature — light team — 3 years later float — user loss.

**Laozi's chapter 26 warning is:**

The moment you are "light" —
- Fast iteration = light = but loses "heavy" = loses "root" = loses "where user is really stuck"
- Light feature = light = but loses "heavy" = loses "root feature"
- Light team = light = but loses "heavy" = loses "core 3 people"
- **"Light" without "heavy" — loses root — loses lord — fail**

The difference:

- "Light" = no matter → Laozi did not say
- "Light" = loses root → Laozi said this

Laozi's chapter 26 diagnosis:

**"Heavy is the root of light" — "heavy" is "light"'s root — you guard "heavy" = guard "where user is really stuck".**

If you **have already** been "light" —

1. **You only chase "fast shipping" — light — loses "where user is really stuck" — loses root**
2. **You only do "light feature" — light — loses "core feature" — loses root**
3. **You only let "light team" do — light — loses "core 3 people" — loses root**
4. **You daily say "we want to be light" — light — loses "why we do" — loses root**

**1 of 4, your "light" is losing "heavy".**

Specifically how to do?

1. **Return to "where user is really stuck" — guard "heavy" — this is "root"**
2. **Do "core feature" — do not do "light feature" — guard "heavy"**
3. **Let "core 3 people" do core — do not let "light team" do core — guard "heavy"**
4. **Return to "why we do" — guard "heavy" — this is "foundation"**

**"Heavy is the root of light" — "heavy" is "light"'s root — guard "heavy" — only then "light" can "light".**
chapters.tension_cn:
**第 25 章**: "道法自然"——"道"= "自然"= "自己"。

**第 26 章**: "重为轻根,静为躁君"——"重"是"轻"的根——"静"是"躁"的君。

两章是同一件事的两个切面——

> **第 25 章: 根本(道=自己)**
> **第 26 章: 具体("重"是"根","静"是"君")**

- 第 25 章教你"回到'自己'——道=自己"
- 第 26 章教你"'重'是'根'——'静'是'君'——守住'重'+'静'"

**"回到自己"+"守重守静"= 根本+具体 = 你在"道"。**
chapters.tension_en:
**Chapter 25**: "Dao follows nature" — "Dao" = "nature" = "self".

**Chapter 26**: "Heavy is the root of light, stillness is the lord of motion" — "heavy" is "light"'s root — "stillness" is "motion"'s lord.

Two chapters are two facets of the same thing —

> **Chapter 25: foundation (Dao = self)**
> **Chapter 26: specifics ("heavy" is "root", "stillness" is "lord")**

- Chapter 25 teaches you "return to 'self' — Dao = self"
- Chapter 26 teaches you "'heavy' is 'root' — 'stillness' is 'lord' — guard 'heavy' + 'stillness'"

**"Return to self" + "guard heavy guard stillness" = foundation + specifics = you are in "Dao".**
chapters.action_cn:
今天你准备做"轻"——快迭代——轻功能——轻团队——之前,**停 3 秒**,问自己——

> "我这个'轻',底下有'重'吗?"

**如果没"重"——失根——别做。**
**如果有"重"——守住"重"——可以做"轻"。**

**"重为轻根"——"重"是"轻"的根——守住"重"——"轻"才能"轻"得起。**
chapters.action_en:
Before you do "light" — fast iteration — light feature — light team — today, **stop 3 seconds**, ask yourself —

> "Does my 'light' have 'heavy' underneath?"

**If no "heavy" — loses root — do not do it.**
**If has "heavy" — guard "heavy" — can do "light".**

**"Heavy is the root of light" — "heavy" is "light"'s root — guard "heavy" — only then "light" can "light".**

chapters.original_cn:
善行无辙迹,善言无瑕谪;善数不用筹策;善闭无关楗而不可开;善结无绳约而不可解。
是以圣人常善救人,故无弃人;常善救物,故无弃物。
是谓袭明。
故善人者,不善人之师;不善人者,善人之资。
不贵其师,不爱其资,虽智大迷,是谓要妙。
chapters.tongshi_cn:
第 27 章是第 26 章的**"善行"落地**。

第 26 章说"重为轻根"——守"重"——但没给"怎么'善'地守重"。
第 27 章直接给 5 个"善"——

> **"善行/善言/善数/善闭/善结"——5 个"善"。**

---

**第 1 段: 5 个"善"。**

老子扔出来 5 个"善":

> **善行无辙迹;**(善走——没辙迹)
> **善言无瑕谪;**(善言——没瑕疵可挑)
> **善数不用筹策;**(善数——不用算筹)
> **善闭无关楗而不可开;**(善闭——没门闩——但打不开)
> **善结无绳约而不可解;**(善结——没绳约——但解不开)

差别:

- 善行 = 走得巧(有技巧) → 老子没说
- 善行 = 不留自己的辙迹(走完像没走过) → 老子说这个

**5 个"善"= 5 个"不留自己的痕迹"。**

你想想——

- **善行** = 不留辙迹 = 走完路 = 看不出谁走的
- **善言** = 不留瑕疵 = 讲完话 = 挑不出毛病
- **善数** = 不用算筹 = 算完 = 看不出怎么算的
- **善闭** = 没用门闩 = 但打不开 = 看不出怎么关的
- **善结** = 没用绳约 = 但解不开 = 看不出怎么结的

**5 个"善"——共同点 = 做完——看不出"谁做的"——"怎么做的"——没辙迹。**

**注意:老子没说"善行=有技巧"——他说"善行=不留辙迹"——"善"是"不留"。**

---

**第 2 段: 是以圣人常善救人,故无弃人;常善救物,故无弃物。**

老子用"圣人"做例子:

> **"是以圣人常善救人"——所以圣人——常善于救人。**
> **"故无弃人"——所以没"弃人"——没"被弃的人"。**
> **"常善救物"——常善于救物。**
> **"故无弃物"——所以没"弃物"——没"被弃的物"。**

差别:

- 圣人救人 = 把人救上来 → 老子没说
- 圣人救人 = 不"弃"人 = 没人被"弃" → 老子说这个

**"弃"= 抛弃。"无弃"= 没抛弃。**

**圣人"救人"——不是说"把坏人变好人"——是说"没人被'弃'"——没人被扔掉。**

你想想——

- 一个 PM "救人" = 大家都不被扔 = 大家都被看见
- 一个 PM "教人" = 把人教成"我这样" = 有人被"弃" = 不被看见

**"常善救人"——常"善"地"救"——不"弃"——这才是"善"。**

---

**第 3 段: 是谓袭明。**

老子盖章:

**"是谓袭明"——这叫"袭明"。**

"袭"= 沿袭 / 顺着;"明"= 明亮 / 看得清。

**"袭明"——沿"明"——沿"那个本来明的东西"——沿"道"。**

差别:

- 善 = 自己的聪明 → 老子没说
- 善 = "袭明"——沿"道"—— → 老子说这个

**"袭明"——"善"= 沿"道"——不是"自己聪明"——是"沿"那个本来明的东西。**

---

**第 4 段: 故善人者,不善人之师;不善人者,善人之资。**

老子给 2 个"互相":

> **"故善人者,不善人之师"——所以"善人"——是"不善人"的"师"。**
> **"不善人者,善人之资"——"不善人"——是"善人"的"资"。**

差别:

- 善人 = 教不善人 → 老子没说
- 善人 = 是"不善人"的"师"= 老师 → 老子说这个

**"师"= 老师。善人是不善人的"老师"——不是说"教"——是"对照"——不善人看善人 = 看见"什么是善"。**

**"资"= 资本 / 资源 / 对照。**注意:这里的"资"不是"资本"——是"借鉴"——"对照"。

**不善人是善人的"资"= "借鉴"——善人从不善人身上"借鉴"——看"什么不是善"。**

你想想——

- 一个 PM 团队里有"善人"= 大家对照"什么是善"
- 一个 PM 团队里有"不善人"= 大家对照"什么不是善"
- **"善人"+"不善人"= 互为对照 = 互为"师"+"资"**

---

**第 5 段: 不贵其师,不爱其资,虽智大迷,是谓要妙。**

最后一句——老子盖章:

> **"不贵其师"——不贵(重视)"师"——不"立"师。**
> **"不爱其资"——不爱(重视)"资"——不"立"资。**
> **"虽智大迷"——虽然看起来智——其实"大迷"——大迷。**
> **"是谓要妙"——这叫"要妙"——关键又奥妙。**

差别:

- "贵师"= 重视师 → 老子没说(最常见)
- "不贵师"= 不"立"师这个标签 → 老子说这个

**"不贵其师"——不"立"师——不立"善人"是"我的老师"——不立这个标签。**

**"不爱其资"——不"立"资——不立"不善人是我的借鉴"——不立这个标签。**

**"虽智大迷"——虽然"看起来"智(聪明)——其实"大迷"——大迷(迷)。**

差别:

- 智 = 真的智 → 老子没说
- 智 = 看起来智 = 大迷 → 老子说这个

**"立"了"师/资"= 看起来"智"= 其实"大迷"。**

**"是谓要妙"——这叫"要妙"——关键又奥妙。**

"要"= 关键(要旨);"妙"= 奥妙(妙不可言)。

**"要妙"——"要"是"要"——"妙"是"妙"——老子说"这个事"——"要"+"妙"——"关键"+"奥妙"。**

---

老子在第 27 章的逻辑是:

**1. 5 个"善"——善行/善言/善数/善闭/善结——共同点 = 不留辙迹**
**2. "圣人常善救人"——常善——不"弃"人——不"弃"物**
**3. "是谓袭明"——"善"= 沿"道"= 沿"那个本来明的东西"**
**4. "善人者,不善人之师;不善人者,善人之资"——互为对照**
**5. "不贵其师,不爱其资"——不"立"师/资——不立标签**
**6. "虽智大迷"——"立"= 看起来智= 大迷**
**7. "是谓要妙"——"要"+"妙"= 关键+奥妙**

**"5 个善"+"不弃"+"袭明"+"不立师/资"+"要妙"= 老子说"沿道+不立"。**
chapters.tongshi_en:
Chapter 27 is chapter 26's **"good travel" landing**.

Chapter 26 said "heavy is the root of light" — guard "heavy" — but did not give "how to 'good'ly guard heavy".
Chapter 27 directly gives 5 "good" —

> **"Good travel / good speaking / good counting / good closing / good tying" — 5 "good".**

---

**Section 1: 5 "good".**

Laozi throws out 5 "good":

> **Good traveling leaves no tracks;**
> **Good speaking leaves no flaws to be picked;**
> **Good counting needs no counting rods;**
> **Good closing needs no bolt yet cannot be opened;**
> **Good tying needs no rope yet cannot be untied.**

The difference:

- Good traveling = walks skillfully (with technique) → Laozi did not say
- Good traveling = leaves no own tracks (after walking like never walked) → Laozi said this

**5 "good" = 5 "leaves no own trace".**

Think about it:

- **Good traveling** = leaves no tracks = after walking the road = cannot see who walked
- **Good speaking** = leaves no flaw = after speaking = cannot find fault
- **Good counting** = no need counting rods = after counting = cannot see how counted
- **Good closing** = no bolt used = but cannot be opened = cannot see how closed
- **Good tying** = no rope used = but cannot be untied = cannot see how tied

**5 "good" — common point = after done — cannot see "who did" — "how did" — no tracks.**

**Note: Laozi did not say "good traveling = has technique" — he said "good traveling = leaves no tracks" — "good" is "leaving no".**

---

**Section 2: Therefore the sage always saves people, therefore no one is abandoned; always saves things, therefore nothing is abandoned.**

Laozi uses "sage" as example:

> **"Therefore the sage always saves people" — so the sage — always good at saving people.**
> **"Therefore no one is abandoned" — so no "abandoned person" — no "person being abandoned".**
> **"Always saves things" — always good at saving things.**
> **"Therefore nothing is abandoned" — so no "abandoned thing" — no "thing being abandoned".**

The difference:

- Sage saves people = rescue people up → Laozi did not say
- Sage saves people = does not "abandon" people = no one is "abandoned" → Laozi said this

**"Abandon" = discard. "No abandon" = no discard.**

**Sage "saves people" — is not saying "change bad people to good people" — is saying "no one is 'abandoned'" — no one is thrown away.**

Think about it:

- A PM "saves people" = everyone is not abandoned = everyone is seen
- A PM "teaches people" = makes people into "me like this" = some are "abandoned" = not seen

**"Always good at saving" — always "good"ly "saves" — does not "abandon" — this is "good".**

---

**Section 3: This is called following brightness.**

Laozi stamps:

**"This is called following brightness" — this is called "following brightness".**

"Following" = along / go with; "brightness" = bright / clearly seen.

**"Following brightness" — along "bright" — along "that originally bright thing" — along "Dao".**

The difference:

- Good = own cleverness → Laozi did not say
- Good = "following brightness" — along "Dao" → Laozi said this

**"Following brightness" — "good" = along "Dao" — is not "own cleverness" — is "along" that originally bright thing.**

---

**Section 4: Therefore good people are the teachers of those who are not good; those who are not good are the resources of good people.**

Laozi gives 2 "mutual":

> **"Therefore good people are the teachers of those who are not good" — so "good people" — are "not good people"'s "teacher".**
> **"Those who are not good are the resources of good people" — "not good people" — are "good people"'s "resource".**

The difference:

- Good people = teach not good people → Laozi did not say
- Good people = are "not good people"'s "teacher" = teacher → Laozi said this

**"Teacher" = teacher. Good people are not good people's "teacher" — is not saying "teach" — is "contrast" — not good people see good people = see "what is good".**

**"Resource" = capital / resource / contrast.** Note: "resource" here is not "capital" — is "reference" — "contrast".

**Not good people are good people's "resource" = "reference" — good people from not good people "reference" — see "what is not good".**

Think about it:

- A PM team has "good people" = everyone contrasts "what is good"
- A PM team has "not good people" = everyone contrasts "what is not good"
- **"Good people" + "not good people" = mutual contrast = mutual "teacher" + "resource"**

---

**Section 5: Do not value the teacher, do not love the resource, though intelligent, is greatly confused. This is called subtle essence.**

Last sentence — Laozi stamps:

> **"Do not value the teacher" — do not value (emphasize) "teacher" — do not "set" teacher.**
> **"Do not love the resource" — do not love (emphasize) "resource" — do not "set" resource.**
> **"Though intelligent, is greatly confused" — though appears intelligent — actually "greatly confused" — greatly confused.**
> **"This is called subtle essence" — this is called "subtle essence" — key and wonderful.**

The difference:

- "Value teacher" = emphasize teacher → Laozi did not say (most common)
- "Do not value teacher" = do not "set" teacher this label → Laozi said this

**"Do not value the teacher" — do not "set" teacher — do not set "good person is my teacher" — do not set this label.**

**"Do not love the resource" — do not "set" resource — do not set "not good person is my reference" — do not set this label.**

**"Though intelligent, is greatly confused" — though "appears" intelligent (clever) — actually "greatly confused" — greatly confused (confused).**

The difference:

- Intelligent = really intelligent → Laozi did not say
- Intelligent = appears intelligent = greatly confused → Laozi said this

**"Set" "teacher/resource" = appears "intelligent" = greatly confused.**

**"This is called subtle essence" — this is called "subtle essence" — "key" and "wonderful".**

"Subtle essence" = key (essentials) + wonderful (wonderful beyond words).

**"Subtle essence" — "key" is "key" — "wonderful" is "wonderful" — Laozi says "this thing" — "key" + "wonderful" — "essential" + "wonderful".**

---

Laozi's logic in chapter 27:

**1. 5 "good" — good travel / good speak / good count / good close / good tie — common point = leaves no tracks**
**2. "Sage always good at saving people" — always good — does not "abandon" people — does not "abandon" things**
**3. "This is called following brightness" — "good" = along "Dao" = along "that originally bright thing"**
**4. "Good people are teachers of not good people; not good people are resources of good people" — mutual contrast**
**5. "Do not value the teacher, do not love the resource" — do not "set" teacher/resource — do not set label**
**6. "Though intelligent, is greatly confused" — "set" = appears intelligent = greatly confused**
**7. "This is called subtle essence" — "key" + "wonderful" = essential + wonderful**

**"5 good" + "do not abandon" + "following brightness" + "do not set teacher/resource" + "subtle essence" = Laozi says "along Dao + do not set".**
chapters.counter_cn:
很多人把第 27 章读成"老子讲善行 / 老子讲善言 / 老子讲善人是不善人的老师"。

**反了。**

老子**没说"善人教不善人"——他说"善人= 不善人的'师'= 师不是教——是'对照'"**。

差别:

- 善人 = 教不善人 → 老子没说
- 善人 = 不善人的"师"= 互为"对照" → 老子说这个

**"师"不是"教"——是"对照"——"我看你——看到'什么是善'"——这是"师"。**

**"资"不是"资本"——是"借鉴"——"你看'不善'——看到'什么不是善'"——这是"资"。**

**"不贵其师,不爱其资"——不"立"师——不"立"资——不立"善人=我的老师"——不立"不善人=我的借鉴"——不立这两个标签。**

你想想——

- 一个人立"我有个好老师"= 标签 = 看起来"我智"= 大迷
- 一个人不立"我有个好老师"= 不立 = 真的"袭明"

**"立"标签 = "看起来智"= 大迷;不"立"= "真的明"= 沿道。**
chapters.counter_en:
Many people read chapter 27 as "Laozi talks about good travel / Laozi talks about good speaking / Laozi talks about good people being teachers of not good people".

**Reversed.**

Laozi **did not say "good people teach not good people" — he said "good people = not good people's 'teacher' = teacher is not 'teach' — is 'contrast'"**.

The difference:

- Good people = teach not good people → Laozi did not say
- Good people = not good people's "teacher" = mutual "contrast" → Laozi said this

**"Teacher" is not "teach" — is "contrast" — "I see you — see 'what is good'" — this is "teacher".**

**"Resource" is not "capital" — is "reference" — "you see 'not good' — see 'what is not good'" — this is "resource".**

**"Do not value the teacher, do not love the resource" — do not "set" teacher — do not "set" resource — do not set "good person = my teacher" — do not set "not good person = my reference" — do not set these two labels.**

Think about it:

- A person sets "I have a good teacher" = label = appears "I am intelligent" = greatly confused
- A person does not set "I have a good teacher" = does not set = really "following brightness"

**"Set" label = "appears intelligent" = greatly confused; do not "set" = "really bright" = along Dao.**
chapters.scene_cn:
你做产品 4 年,带 5 人小团队。

你本能反应:**教人**——讲"我懂"——讲"我做的是对的"——讲"我功劳大"——3 年后团队不成长。

**老子第 27 章的警告是:**

你"教人"的那一刻——
- 你讲"我懂用户" = 留辙迹 = 团队看不到自己懂
- 你讲"我做的是对的" = 留辙迹 = 团队看不到自己对
- 你讲"我功劳大" = 留辙迹 = 团队看不到自己功
- **"教"——就是留辙迹——5 个"善"= 不留辙迹——别教——让团队自己悟**

差别:

- 教 = 留辙迹(让团队跟) → 老子没说
- 不教 = 不留辙迹(让团队自悟) → 老子说这个

老子第 27 章的诊断:

**"善行无辙迹"——善走——不留辙迹——你别教——让团队自悟。**

如果你**已经**"教"了——

1. **你讲"我懂用户"——留辙迹——团队看不到自己懂**
2. **你讲"我做的是对的"——留辙迹——团队看不到自己对**
3. **你讲"我功劳大"——留辙迹——团队看不到自己功**
4. **你讲"我比你们强"——留辙迹——团队看不到自己强**

**4 条占 1 条,你的"教"在变"留辙迹"。**

具体怎么做?

1. **不"教"——不立"我懂"——让团队自己悟**
2. **不"教"——不立"我对"——让团队自己对**
3. **不"教"——不立"我功"——让团队自己功**
4. **不"教"——不立"我强"——让团队自己强**

**"善行无辙迹"——善走——不留辙迹——别"教"——让团队自悟。**
chapters.scene_en:
You have been doing product for 4 years, leading a 5-person team.

Your instinctive reaction: **teach people** — say "I understand" — say "what I do is right" — say "my contribution is great" — 3 years later team does not grow.

**Laozi's chapter 27 warning is:**

The moment you "teach" —
- You say "I understand users" = leave tracks = team cannot see themselves understand
- You say "what I do is right" = leave tracks = team cannot see themselves right
- You say "my contribution is great" = leave tracks = team cannot see themselves have contribution
- **"Teach" — is leaving tracks — 5 "good" = leaves no tracks — do not teach — let team realize themselves**

The difference:

- Teach = leave tracks (let team follow) → Laozi did not say
- Do not teach = leaves no tracks (let team realize themselves) → Laozi said this

Laozi's chapter 27 diagnosis:

**"Good traveling leaves no tracks" — good travel — leaves no tracks — do not teach — let team realize themselves.**

If you **have already** "taught" —

1. **You say "I understand users" — leave tracks — team cannot see themselves understand**
2. **You say "what I do is right" — leave tracks — team cannot see themselves right**
3. **You say "my contribution is great" — leave tracks — team cannot see themselves have contribution**
4. **You say "I am stronger than you" — leave tracks — team cannot see themselves strong**

**1 of 4, your "teach" is becoming "leaving tracks".**

Specifically how to do?

1. **Do not "teach" — do not set "I understand" — let team realize themselves**
2. **Do not "teach" — do not set "I am right" — let team be right themselves**
3. **Do not "teach" — do not set "I have contribution" — let team have contribution themselves**
4. **Do not "teach" — do not set "I am strong" — let team be strong themselves**

**"Good traveling leaves no tracks" — good travel — leaves no tracks — do not "teach" — let team realize themselves.**
chapters.tension_cn:
**第 26 章**: "重为轻根,静为躁君"——"重"是"根"——"静"是"君"——守"重"守"静"。

**第 27 章**: "善行无辙迹"——善走——不留辙迹——"不教"——让团队自悟。

两章是同一件事的两个切面——

> **第 26 章: 守"重"守"静"**
> **第 27 章: "善"= 不留辙迹**

- 第 26 章教你"守'重'+'静'"
- 第 27 章教你"'善'= 不留辙迹——不'立'标签"

**"守重守静"+"不留辙迹"= 守"重"+"不教"= 你在"道"。**
chapters.tension_en:
**Chapter 26**: "Heavy is the root of light, stillness is the lord of motion" — "heavy" is "root" — "stillness" is "lord" — guard "heavy" guard "stillness".

**Chapter 27**: "Good traveling leaves no tracks" — good travel — leaves no tracks — "do not teach" — let team realize themselves.

Two chapters are two facets of the same thing —

> **Chapter 26: guard "heavy" guard "stillness"**
> **Chapter 27: "good" = leaves no tracks**

- Chapter 26 teaches you "guard 'heavy' + 'stillness'"
- Chapter 27 teaches you "'good' = leaves no tracks — do not 'set' label"

**"Guard heavy guard stillness" + "leaves no tracks" = guard "heavy" + "do not teach" = you are in "Dao".**
chapters.action_cn:
今天你准备"教"团队之前,**停 3 秒**,问自己——

> "我这个'教',是'留辙迹'还是'不留辙迹'?"

**如果是"留辙迹"——立"我"这个标签——别教——让团队自悟。**
**如果是"不留辙迹"——不立"我"——可以"教"——但不是"教"——是"让团队自悟"。**

**"善行无辙迹"——善走——不留辙迹——别"教"——让团队自悟。**
chapters.action_en:
Before you "teach" the team today, **stop 3 seconds**, ask yourself —

> "Is my 'teach' 'leaving tracks' or 'leaving no tracks'?"

**If it is "leaving tracks" — sets "I" this label — do not teach — let team realize themselves.**
**If it is "leaving no tracks" — does not set "I" — can "teach" — but is not "teach" — is "let team realize themselves".**

**"Good traveling leaves no tracks" — good travel — leaves no tracks — do not "teach" — let team realize themselves.**

chapters.tongshi_cn:
第 28 章是第 27 章的**对立面互相转化版**。

第 27 章说"善行无辙迹"——不留辙迹——但没讲对立面。
第 28 章直接给 3 对"对立面"——

> **"知其雄,守其雌"**
> **"知其白,守其黑"**
> **"知其荣,守其辱"**

---

**第 1 段: 3 对"知+守"。**

老子扔出来 3 对"对立面":

> **知其雄,守其雌;**(知道"雄",守住"雌")
> **知其白,守其黑;**(知道"白",守住"黑")
> **知其荣,守其辱;**(知道"荣",守住"辱")

差别:

- 知+守 = 2 个动作 → 老子没说(表面)
- 知+守 = "知对立面+守另一点"= 1 个动作 → 老子说这个

**3 对"知+守"——共同点 = 知道"雄/白/荣"——守住"雌/黑/辱"——守住"另一点"。**

你想想——

- **知其雄** = 知道"雄"长啥样(刚/强/动)
- **守其雌** = 守住"雌"= 守住"软/弱/静"
- **"知"+"守"= 知道"雄"+守住"雌"= 知道对立面——守住另一点**

**"雄"和"雌"——是对立——"知+守"= 同时看两边——守在"雌"——不守在"雄"。**

---

**第 2 段: 为天下谿/式/谷,常德不离/不忒/乃足,复归于婴儿/无极/朴。**

老子接着给 3 个"为"和 3 个"复归":

> **"为天下谿"——为天下的谿(溪流)。"常德不离"——常德不离。"复归于婴儿"——复归于"婴儿"。**
> **"为天下式"——为天下的式(模式)。"常德不忒"——常德不忒(差错)。"复归于无极"——复归于"无极"。**
> **"为天下谷"——为天下的谷(山谷)。"常德乃足"——常德才足。"复归于朴"——复归于"朴"。**

差别:

- "谿/式/谷"= 3 个名词 = 3 个东西 → 老子没说
- "谿/式/谷"= 3 个"低/中/深"= 守在"低" → 老子说这个

**"谿"= 溪流(低处的);"式"= 模式(中间的);"谷"= 山谷(深处的)——3 个都"低"。**

**"复归于婴儿/无极/朴"——3 个"复归"——3 个"未雕"——"婴儿"(未长成)/"无极"(无边界)/"朴"(未雕的木头)。**

差别:

- "复归"= 回到过去 → 老子没说
- "复归"= 回到"未雕"= 回到"自然"= 婴儿/无极/朴 → 老子说这个

**"复归"——不是"回到过去"——是"回到'未雕'"——回到"自然"——3 个"未雕"的同义词。**

---

**第 3 段: 朴散则为器,圣人用之,则为官长,故大制不割。**

老子给"朴"的用途:

> **"朴散则为器"——"朴"散开——变成"器"(器具)。**
> **"圣人用之,则为官长"——圣人用它——则作"官长"。**
> **"故大制不割"——所以"大制"不"割"——不切。**

差别:

- "朴"= 散开= 失败 → 老子没说
- "朴"= 散开= 变成"器"= 工具 → 老子说这个

**"朴"散开——变成"器"——工具。"器"是"工具"——是"被用"的。**

**"圣人用之,则为官长"——圣人用"朴"——则作"官长"(管理者)——用"朴"作工具——管理。**

**"故大制不割"——"大制"(大的制度/大的治理)——不"割"(不切)。**

差别:

- 大制 = 切分 → 老子没说
- 大制 = 不切分 → 老子说这个

**"大制"= 大的治理= 不切分= 整体= "朴"——"朴"是整体的,不是切分的。**

---

老子在第 28 章的逻辑是:

**1. 3 对"知+守"——知"雄/白/荣"+守"雌/黑/辱"——对立面互相转化**
**2. "为天下谿/式/谷"——3 个"低"的位置——谿/式/谷**
**3. "复归于婴儿/无极/朴"——3 个"未雕"= 自然= 复归**
**4. "朴散则为器"——"朴"散开= 工具**
**5. "圣人用之,则为官长"——圣人用"朴"= 管理**
**6. "大制不割"——"大制"= "朴"= 整体= 不切**

**"知+守"+"复归"+"朴散为器"+"大制不割"= 老子说"知对立面+复归未雕+整体不切"。**
chapters.tongshi_en:
Chapter 28 is chapter 27's **opposite transformation version**.

Chapter 27 said "good traveling leaves no tracks" — leaves no tracks — but did not talk about opposites.
Chapter 28 directly gives 3 "opposites" —

> **"Know the male, guard the female"**
> **"Know the white, guard the black"**
> **"Know the honored, guard the humble"**

---

**Section 1: 3 "know + guard".**

Laozi throws out 3 "opposites":

> **Know the male, guard the female;**
> **Know the white, guard the black;**
> **Know the honored, guard the humble.**

The difference:

- Know + guard = 2 actions → Laozi did not say (surface)
- Know + guard = "know opposite + guard other side" = 1 action → Laozi said this

**3 "know + guard" — common point = know "male/white/honored" — guard "female/black/humble" — guard "other side".**

Think about it:

- **Know the male** = know what "male" looks like (hard / strong / moving)
- **Guard the female** = guard "female" = guard "soft / weak / still"
- **"Know" + "guard" = know "male" + guard "female" = know opposite — guard other side**

**"Male" and "female" — are opposites — "know + guard" = simultaneously see both sides — guard at "female" — not guard at "male".**

---

**Section 2: Be the stream/model/valley of the world, constant virtue does not depart/err/is sufficient, return to infant/boundless/uncarved block.**

Laozi then gives 3 "be" and 3 "return":

> **"Be the stream of the world" — be the world's stream (creek). "Constant virtue does not depart" — constant virtue does not depart. "Return to the state of the infant" — return to "infant".**
> **"Be the model of the world" — be the world's model. "Constant virtue does not err" — constant virtue does not err. "Return to the boundless" — return to "boundless".**
> **"Be the valley of the world" — be the world's valley. "Constant virtue is sufficient" — constant virtue is sufficient. "Return to the uncarved block" — return to "uncarved block".**

The difference:

- "Stream / model / valley" = 3 nouns = 3 things → Laozi did not say
- "Stream / model / valley" = 3 "low/middle/deep" = guard at "low" → Laozi said this

**"Stream" = creek (low place); "model" = model (middle place); "valley" = mountain valley (deep place) — 3 all "low".**

**"Return to infant / boundless / uncarved block" — 3 "return" — 3 "uncarved" — "infant" (not yet grown) / "boundless" (no boundary) / "uncarved block" (not yet carved wood).**

The difference:

- "Return" = return to past → Laozi did not say
- "Return" = return to "uncarved" = return to "natural" = infant / boundless / uncarved block → Laozi said this

**"Return" — is not "return to the past" — is "return to 'uncarved'" — return to "natural" — 3 synonyms of "uncarved".**

---

**Section 3: The uncarved block, scattered, becomes vessels; the sage uses them, then becomes the ruler. Therefore the great ruling does not cut.**

Laozi gives the use of "uncarved block":

> **"The uncarved block, scattered, becomes vessels" — "uncarved block" scattered — becomes "vessels" (implements).**
> **"The sage uses them, then becomes the ruler" — the sage uses them — then becomes "ruler" (manager).**
> **"Therefore the great ruling does not cut" — so "great ruling" (great governance) — does not "cut" (does not separate).**

The difference:

- "Uncarved block" = scattered = fail → Laozi did not say
- "Uncarved block" = scattered = becomes "vessel" = tool → Laozi said this

**"Uncarved block" scattered — becomes "vessel" — tool. "Vessel" is "tool" — is "to be used".**

**"The sage uses them, then becomes the ruler" — the sage uses "uncarved block" — then becomes "ruler" (manager) — uses "uncarved block" as tool — manage.**

**"Therefore the great ruling does not cut" — "great ruling" (great governance) — does not "cut" (does not separate).**

The difference:

- Great ruling = separate → Laozi did not say
- Great ruling = does not separate → Laozi said this

**"Great ruling" = great governance = does not separate = whole = "uncarved block" — "uncarved block" is whole, is not separated.**

---

Laozi's logic in chapter 28:

**1. 3 "know + guard" — know "male/white/honored" + guard "female/black/humble" — opposites transform**
**2. "Be the stream/model/valley of the world" — 3 "low" positions — stream / model / valley**
**3. "Return to infant / boundless / uncarved block" — 3 "uncarved" = natural = return**
**4. "The uncarved block scattered becomes vessels" — "uncarved block" scattered = tool**
**5. "The sage uses them, then becomes the ruler" — sage uses "uncarved block" = manage**
**6. "The great ruling does not cut" — "great ruling" = "uncarved block" = whole = does not cut**

**"Know + guard" + "return" + "uncarved block scattered becomes vessels" + "great ruling does not cut" = Laozi says "know opposite + return uncarved + whole does not cut".**
chapters.counter_cn:
很多人把第 28 章读成"老子讲守柔弱 / 老子讲守朴 / 老子讲'朴'是没用的木头"。

**反了。**

老子**没说"守柔弱就好"——他说"知'雄'+守'雌'"——"知对立面+守另一点"——3 对都"知+守"**。

差别:

- 老子讲守柔弱 → 老子没说
- 老子讲"知+守"= 知对立面+守另一点 → 老子说这个

**"知+守"——"知"+"守"——"知"是"知道对立面"——"守"是"守住另一点"——是 1 个动作——同时。**

你想想——

- 一个人"知雄守雌"= 知道"刚/强/动"——守住"软/弱/静"
- 一个人"知白守黑"= 知道"亮/显"——守住"暗/隐"
- 一个人"知荣守辱"= 知道"尊/显"——守住"卑/隐"

**3 对"知+守"= 3 对"对立面"= 同时看两边——守在"另一点"。**

**老子没说"软/暗/卑"好——他说"知'刚/亮/尊'+守'软/暗/卑'"= 对立面。**
chapters.counter_en:
Many people read chapter 28 as "Laozi talks about guarding the soft and weak / Laozi talks about guarding the uncarved / Laozi talks about 'uncarved block' is useless wood".

**Reversed.**

Laozi **did not say "guarding soft and weak is good" — he said "know 'male' + guard 'female'" — "know opposite + guard other side" — 3 "know + guard"**.

The difference:

- Laozi talks about guarding soft and weak → Laozi did not say
- Laozi talks about "know + guard" = know opposite + guard other side → Laozi said this

**"Know + guard" — "know" + "guard" — "know" is "know opposite" — "guard" is "guard other side" — is 1 action — simultaneously.**

Think about it:

- A person "know male guard female" = know "hard / strong / moving" — guard "soft / weak / still"
- A person "know white guard black" = know "bright / showy" — guard "dark / hidden"
- A person "know honored guard humble" = know "lofty / showy" — guard "lowly / hidden"

**3 "know + guard" = 3 "opposites" = simultaneously see both sides — guard at "other side".**

**Laozi did not say "soft / dark / lowly" is good — he said "know 'hard / bright / lofty' + guard 'soft / dark / lowly'" = opposites.**
chapters.scene_cn:
你做产品 4 年,在公司里讲"我们要冲增长"。

你本能反应:**雄**——冲——增长——刚——强——3 年后团队疲。

**老子第 28 章的警告是:**

你"雄"的那一刻——
- 你讲"我们要增长" = 雄 = 但失了"雌"= 失了"用户真的卡什么"
- 你讲"我们要扩张" = 雄 = 但失了"雌"= 失了"团队稳不稳"
- 你讲"我们要赢" = 雄 = 但失了"雌"= 失了"我们为什么做"
- **"雄"立出来 = "雌"不见了 = "知其雄,守其雌"——知道"雄"——守住"雌"**

差别:

- "雄"= 赢 → 老子没说
- "知雄守雌"= 知对立面+守另一点 → 老子说这个

老子第 28 章的诊断:

**"知其雄,守其雌"——知道"雄"——守住"雌"——别"立雄"。**

如果你**已经**"雄"了——

1. **你讲"我们要增长"——雄——守住"用户真的卡什么"——雌**
2. **你讲"我们要扩张"——雄——守住"团队稳不稳"——雌**
3. **你讲"我们要赢"——雄——守住"我们为什么做"——雌**
4. **你讲"我们要第一"——雄——守住"我们是谁"——雌**

**4 条占 1 条,你的"雄"在失"雌"。**

具体怎么做?

1. **知"增长"——守"用户"——守住"雌"**
2. **知"扩张"——守"团队"——守住"雌"**
3. **知"赢"——守"我们为什么做"——守住"雌"**
4. **知"第一"——守"我们是谁"——守住"雌"**

**"知其雄,守其雌"——知道"雄"——守住"雌"——"朴散则为器"——"朴"才是根。**
chapters.scene_en:
You have been doing product for 4 years, at the company saying "we want to chase growth".

Your instinctive reaction: **male** — chase — growth — hard — strong — 3 years later team is tired.

**Laozi's chapter 28 warning is:**

The moment you are "male" —
- You say "we want growth" = male = but loses "female" = loses "where user is really stuck"
- You say "we want to expand" = male = but loses "female" = loses "is team steady"
- You say "we want to win" = male = but loses "female" = loses "why we do"
- **"Male" set out = "female" not seen = "know the male, guard the female" — know "male" — guard "female"**

The difference:

- "Male" = win → Laozi did not say
- "Know male guard female" = know opposite + guard other side → Laozi said this

Laozi's chapter 28 diagnosis:

**"Know the male, guard the female" — know "male" — guard "female" — do not "set male".**

If you **have already** been "male" —

1. **You say "we want growth" — male — guard "where user is really stuck" — female**
2. **You say "we want to expand" — male — guard "is team steady" — female**
3. **You say "we want to win" — male — guard "why we do" — female**
4. **You say "we want to be first" — male — guard "who we are" — female**

**1 of 4, your "male" is losing "female".**

Specifically how to do?

1. **Know "growth" — guard "user" — guard "female"**
2. **Know "expansion" — guard "team" — guard "female"**
3. **Know "win" — guard "why we do" — guard "female"**
4. **Know "first" — guard "who we are" — guard "female"**

**"Know the male, guard the female" — know "male" — guard "female" — "the uncarved block scattered becomes vessels" — "uncarved block" is the root.**
chapters.tension_cn:
**第 27 章**: "善行无辙迹"——善走——不留辙迹——"不教"——让团队自悟。

**第 28 章**: "知其雄,守其雌"——知对立面——守另一点——3 对"知+守"。

两章是同一件事的两个切面——

> **第 27 章: 不留辙迹(不立标签)**
> **第 28 章: 知对立面+守另一点(知+守)**

- 第 27 章教你"不'立'标签"
- 第 28 章教你"知'雄'+守'雌'= 知对立面+守另一点"

**"不立"+"知+守"= 不立"雄"+"守'雌'"= 你在"朴"。**
chapters.tension_en:
**Chapter 27**: "Good traveling leaves no tracks" — good travel — leaves no tracks — "do not teach" — let team realize themselves.

**Chapter 28**: "Know the male, guard the female" — know opposite — guard other side — 3 "know + guard".

Two chapters are two facets of the same thing —

> **Chapter 27: leaves no tracks (do not set label)**
> **Chapter 28: know + guard (know opposite + guard other side)**

- Chapter 27 teaches you "do not 'set' label"
- Chapter 28 teaches you "know 'male' + guard 'female' = know opposite + guard other side"

**"Do not set" + "know + guard" = do not set "male" + guard "female" = you are in "uncarved block".**
chapters.action_cn:
今天你准备立"雄"——冲——增长——强——之前,**停 3 秒**,问自己——

> "我立的这个'雄',对应'雌'是什么?"

**如果知道"雄"+知道"雌"= 知+守——立"雄"可以。**
**如果只知"雄"+不知"雌"= 不守——别立。**

**"知其雄,守其雌"——知道"雄"——守住"雌"——别只"知雄"——要"守雌"。**
chapters.action_en:
Before you set "male" — chase — growth — strong — today, **stop 3 seconds**, ask yourself —

> "The 'male' I am setting, what is the corresponding 'female'?"

**If know "male" + know "female" = know + guard — can set "male".**
**If only know "male" + do not know "female" = not guard — do not set.**

**"Know the male, guard the female" — know "male" — guard "female" — do not only "know male" — must "guard female".**

chapters.original_cn:
将欲取天下而为之,吾见其不得已。
天下神器,不可为也,不可执也。
为者败之,执者失之。
故物或行或随,或歔或吹,或强或赢,或载或隳。

chapters.original_en:
Wants to take the world and act on it,
I see it has no way to succeed.
The world is a sacred vessel,
cannot be acted on,
cannot be grasped.
Those who act on it, ruin it.
Those who grasp it, lose it.
Therefore things may go ahead or follow,
may blow gently or harshly,
may be strong or weak,
may rise or fall.
Therefore the sage removes excess,
removes extravagance,
removes arrogance.
chapters.tongshi_cn:
第 29 章是第 28 章的**"不可为"版本**。

第 28 章说"知其雄守其雌"——知对立面+守另一点——但没讲"想取天下会怎样"。
第 29 章直接给"想取天下+为之会怎样"——

> **"将欲取天下而为之,吾见其不得已"——想取天下而为之——我看"他"——"他"——"已"——"不得"——不行。**

---

**第 1 段: 将欲取天下而为之,吾见其不得已。**

"将欲"= 想;"取天下"= 取天下;"为之"= 为之(强为)。

翻译: **想取天下而强为——我看"他"——"他"——"已"——"不得"——不行。**

差别:

- 想取天下 = 能取 → 老子没说
- 想取天下 + 为之 = 不得(不行) → 老子说这个

**"取"——取天下——把天下当作"对象"——"强为"——用"我"这个"为"——去"取"天下。**

**"不得已"——"已"= 已经——"不得"= 不得——已经"不得"了——做不到。**

你想想——

- 一个 PM "想取天下"= 想"做行业第一"——为之——为这个目标去"为"——3 年后撑不住
- 一个 PM "想取天下"= 但不为之——不把这个目标当"对象"——1 年后稳

**"想"+"为"——两个动作——"想"是"想","为"是"强为"——"为"才是失败的原因。**

---

**第 2 段: 天下神器,不可为也,不可执也。**

老子给"天下"的画像:

> **"天下神器"——天下是"神器"。**
> **"不可为也"——不可"为"。**
> **"不可执也"——不可"执"。**

"神"= 神(不可测);"器"= 器(器具)。

差别:

- 天下 = 东西 = 可为/可执 → 老子没说
- 天下 = "神器"= 不可为+不可执 → 老子说这个

**"神器"——"神"+"器"——"神"= 不可测;"器"= 器具。**

**"天下"——是"不可测"+"器具"——"不可测"——不能"为"——不能"执"。**

**"不可为"——不可"强为"——"为" = 强为——老子说不行。**

**"不可执"——不可"抓"——"执" = 抓住——老子说不行。**

---

**第 3 段: 为者败之,执者失之。**

老子盖章:

> **"为者败之"——"为"的人——败——"为"——败。**
> **"执者失之"——"执"的人——失——"执"——失。**

差别:

- 为 = 成功 → 老子没说
- 为 = 败 → 老子说这个

**"为"——"强为"——失败。**
**"执"——"抓"——失去。**

**3 个字总结: "为"败,"执"失。**

---

**第 4 段: 故物或行或随,或歔或吹,或强或赢,或载或隳。**

老子给"物"的 4 对"或":

> **"或行或随"——或"行"——或"随"。**
> **"或歔或吹"——或"歔"——或"吹"。**
> **"或强或赢"——或"强"——或"赢"。**
> **"或载或隳"——或"载"——或"隳"。**

差别:

- 物 = 一致 → 老子没说
- 物 = 4 对"或"——不一 → 老子说这个

**"物"——东西——是多样的——"或"——不一。**

**4 对"或":**

- **或行或随** = 或"前"或"随"——或"动"或"跟"
- **或歔或吹** = 或"温和的"或"急的"——"歔"= 叹气(温和);"吹"= 吹气(急)
- **或强或赢** = 或"强"或"赢"——"赢"= 弱(老子的"赢"= 弱)
- **或载或隳** = 或"载"或"隳"——"载"= 载起;"隳"= 毁坏

**"物"——多种——不一——你不能"强为"——你不能"执"——因为物本身就是"或"。**

---

**第 5 段: 是以圣人去甚,去奢,去泰。**

最后一句——老子给"圣人"的 3 个"去":

> **"是以圣人去甚"——所以圣人——去"甚"。**
> **"去奢"——去"奢"。**
> **"去泰"——去"泰"。**

差别:

- 圣人 = 加东西 → 老子没说
- 圣人 = 去"甚/奢/泰" → 老子说这个

**"甚"= 过分(过头);"奢"= 奢侈;"泰"= 极端/过稳(过稳也是极端)。**

**"去甚"——去掉"过分"——别过头。**
**"去奢"——去掉"奢侈"——别铺张。**
**"去泰"——去掉"极端"——别极端(过稳也是极端)。**

**3 个"去"——3 个"去掉"——"过/奢/极"。**

你想想——

- 一个人讲"我们要极致"= 甚 = 过头 = 失败
- 一个人讲"我们要铺张"= 奢 = 失败
- 一个人讲"我们要极端"= 泰 = 失败

**3 个"去"——"去过头"——"去铺张"——"去极端"——别"加"——"减"。**

---

老子在第 29 章的逻辑是:

**1. "将欲取天下而为之,吾见其不得已"——想取+为之= 不得(不行)**
**2. "天下神器,不可为也,不可执也"——天下= 神器= 不可为+不可执**
**3. "为者败之,执者失之"——为=败,执=失**
**4. "物或行或随,或歔或吹,或强或赢,或载或隳"——物= 多种= 或**
**5. "圣人去甚,去奢,去泰"——去过头/去铺张/去极端——3 个"去"**

**"想+为=不得"+"不可为/执"+"为败/执失"+"物或"+"去甚/奢/泰"= 老子说"别强为+别执+去过"。**
chapters.tongshi_en:
Chapter 29 is chapter 28's **"cannot act on" version**.

Chapter 28 said "know the male, guard the female" — know opposite + guard other side — but did not talk about "what happens if you want to take the world".
Chapter 29 directly gives "what happens if you want to take the world + act on it" —

> **"Wants to take the world and act on it, I see it has no way to succeed" — wants to take the world and force-act — I see "it" — "it" — "already" — "cannot" — cannot do.**

---

**Section 1: Wants to take the world and act on it, I see it has no way to succeed.**

"Want" = want; "take the world" = take the world; "act on it" = force-act on it (act strongly).

Translation: **Wants to take the world and force-act — I see "it" — "it" — "already" — "cannot" — cannot do.**

The difference:

- Want to take the world = can take → Laozi did not say
- Want to take the world + act on it = cannot (cannot do) → Laozi said this

**"Take" — take the world — treat the world as "object" — "force-act" — use "I" this "act" — to "take" the world.**

**"Has no way to succeed" — "already" = already — "cannot" = cannot — already "cannot" — cannot do.**

Think about it:

- A PM "wants to take the world" = wants to "be category leader" — force-act on this goal — 3 years later cannot hold
- A PM "wants to take the world" = but does not force-act — does not treat this goal as "object" — 1 year later steady

**"Want" + "act" — two actions — "want" is "want", "act" is "force-act" — "act" is the cause of failure.**

---

**Section 2: The world is a sacred vessel, cannot be acted on, cannot be grasped.**

Laozi gives the "world"'s portrait:

> **"The world is a sacred vessel" — the world is "sacred vessel".**
> **"Cannot be acted on" — cannot "act".**
> **"Cannot be grasped" — cannot "grasp".**

"Sacred" = divine (immeasurable); "vessel" = vessel (implement).

The difference:

- World = thing = can act / can grasp → Laozi did not say
- World = "sacred vessel" = cannot act + cannot grasp → Laozi said this

**"Sacred vessel" — "sacred" + "vessel" — "sacred" = immeasurable; "vessel" = implement.**

**"World" — is "immeasurable" + "implement" — "immeasurable" — cannot "act" — cannot "grasp".**

**"Cannot be acted on" — cannot "force-act" — "act" = force-act — Laozi says cannot.**

**"Cannot be grasped" — cannot "grab" — "grasp" = grab — Laozi says cannot.**

---

**Section 3: Those who act on it, ruin it. Those who grasp it, lose it.**

Laozi stamps:

> **"Those who act on it, ruin it" — "act" person — ruin — "act" — ruin.**
> **"Those who grasp it, lose it" — "grasp" person — lose — "grasp" — lose.**

The difference:

- Act = succeed → Laozi did not say
- Act = ruin → Laozi said this

**"Act" — "force-act" — fail.**
**"Grasp" — "grab" — lose.**

**3-word summary: "act" ruin, "grasp" lose.**

---

**Section 4: Therefore things may go ahead or follow, may blow gently or harshly, may be strong or weak, may rise or fall.**

Laozi gives 4 "either/or" pairs of "things":

> **"May go ahead or follow" — may "go" — may "follow".**
> **"May blow gently or harshly" — may "gentle" — may "harsh".**
> **"May be strong or weak" — may "strong" — may "weak".**
> **"May rise or fall" — may "rise" — may "fall".**

The difference:

- Things = consistent → Laozi did not say
- Things = 4 "either/or" pairs — not one → Laozi said this

**"Things" — stuff — is diverse — "either" — not one.**

**4 "either/or" pairs:**

- **May go ahead or follow** = may "front" or "follow" — may "move" or "follow"
- **May blow gently or harshly** = may "gentle" or "harsh" — "gentle" = sigh (gentle); "harsh" = blow (harsh)
- **May be strong or weak** = may "strong" or "weak" — "weak" = weak
- **May rise or fall** = may "carry" or "destroy" — "carry" = carry up; "destroy" = destroy

**"Things" — diverse — not one — you cannot "force-act" — you cannot "grasp" — because things themselves are "either".**

---

**Section 5: Therefore the sage removes excess, removes extravagance, removes arrogance.**

Last sentence — Laozi gives "sage"'s 3 "remove":

> **"Therefore the sage removes excess" — so the sage — removes "excess".**
> **"Removes extravagance" — removes "extravagance".**
> **"Removes arrogance" — removes "arrogance".**

The difference:

- Sage = add things → Laozi did not say
- Sage = removes "excess / extravagance / arrogance" → Laozi said this

**"Excess" = over-the-top (too much); "extravagance" = luxury; "arrogance" = extreme / over-stable (over-stable is also extreme).**

**"Remove excess" — remove "over-the-top" — do not be excessive.**
**"Remove extravagance" — remove "luxury" — do not be lavish.**
**"Remove arrogance" — remove "extreme" — do not be extreme (over-stable is also extreme).**

**3 "remove" — 3 "remove" — "excessive / extravagant / extreme".**

Think about it:

- A person says "we want to be ultimate" = excess = over-the-top = fail
- A person says "we want to be lavish" = extravagance = fail
- A person says "we want to be extreme" = arrogance = fail

**3 "remove" — "remove excessive" — "remove lavish" — "remove extreme" — do not "add" — "subtract".**

---

Laozi's logic in chapter 29:

**1. "Wants to take the world and act on it, I see it has no way to succeed" — want + act = cannot (cannot do)**
**2. "The world is a sacred vessel, cannot be acted on, cannot be grasped" — world = sacred vessel = cannot act + cannot grasp**
**3. "Those who act on it, ruin it. Those who grasp it, lose it" — act = ruin, grasp = lose**
**4. "Things may go ahead or follow..." — things = diverse = either**
**5. "The sage removes excess, removes extravagance, removes arrogance" — remove excessive / remove lavish / remove extreme — 3 "remove"**

**"Want + act = cannot" + "cannot act / grasp" + "act ruin / grasp lose" + "things either" + "remove excessive / extravagance / arrogance" = Laozi says "do not force-act + do not grasp + remove excess".**
chapters.counter_cn:
很多人把第 29 章读成"老子讲不可为 / 老子讲不可执 / 老子讲圣人去甚去奢去泰"。

**反了。**

老子**没说"不可为"是"啥都不做"——他说"为者败之"——"为"= "强为"= 强——为"——不是"做"**。

差别:

- 不可为 = 啥都不做 → 老子没说(误读)
- 不可为 = 不可"强为"——为"="强为"= 强——为"—— → 老子说这个

**"为"——在老子这里——不是"做"——是"强为"——"强"——为——用"我"这个"为"去"为"。**

**"为"——是"立'我'这个'为'的标签"——"立" = 强为——失败。**

**"做"——不是"为"——"做"是"做事"——"为"是"强为"——两个东西。**

你想想——

- 一个人"做事"= 做事 = 不强为
- 一个人"强为"= 立"我" = 失败

**"做事" ≠ "强为"——"做事"是做事——"强为"是立"我"——别混。**
chapters.counter_en:
Many people read chapter 29 as "Laozi talks about cannot act / Laozi talks about cannot grasp / Laozi talks about sage removing excess extravagance arrogance".

**Reversed.**

Laozi **did not say "cannot act" is "do nothing" — he said "those who act on it, ruin it" — "act" = "force-act" = "force" — "act" — is not "do"**.

The difference:

- Cannot act = do nothing → Laozi did not say (misread)
- Cannot act = cannot "force-act" — "act" = "force-act" = "force" — "act" — → Laozi said this
